6.Collection.2026.season1.startDialogue.0: Have you noticed how the days have grown brighter? Even an ordinary morning feels different now. The air feels so light... so springlike.
6.Collection.2026.season1.startDialogue.1: Spring is starting to take over. It brings warmth and light into every moment!
6.Collection.2026.season1.startDialogue.2: And those moments are all so different... a ray of sunshine, a warm breeze, the first flowers.
6.Collection.2026.season1.startDialogue.3: Exactly. Little joys that come together to create a true spring mood. It’s a shame these days pass by so quickly...
6.Collection.2026.season1.startDialogue.4: You know... maybe we can try to keep them! Gather everything bright that spring brings!
6.Collection.2026.season1.startDialogue.5: That’s a wonderful idea! Let’s try not to miss a single moment. May these bright days stay with us for as long as possible!
6.Collection.2026.season2.startDialogue.0: It feels like summer has burst into Gardenridge at full speed. The sun’s so bright from the very morning that your mood lifts all by itself!
6.Collection.2026.season2.startDialogue.1: Yeah, it makes you want to spend every day outside with a cup of ice cream in hand, not thinking about anything serious.
6.Collection.2026.season2.startDialogue.2: Sometimes it feels like the best memories are made from things that simple.
6.Collection.2026.season2.startDialogue.3: Exactly! The important thing is not letting them fade away without a trace…
6.Collection.2026.season2.startDialogue.4: Then let’s gather everything that makes this summer special — so not a single hot day goes to waste!
6.Collection.2026.season3.startDialogue.0: Sofia, do you hear that? Feels like the sea is calling! Salty air, crashing waves… makes you want to head straight to the beach.
6.Collection.2026.season3.startDialogue.1: Oh, I can already imagine it — warm sand under my feet, sunlight in my hair, seashells along the shore... A true summer adventure!
6.Collection.2026.season3.startDialogue.2: Adventure really is the perfect word! Every day by the sea brings something new — a curious shell one moment, a breathtaking sunset the next...
6.Collection.2026.season3.startDialogue.3: Those are the moments that make summer unforgettable. It’s just a shame they slip away so quickly, like sand through your fingers...
6.Collection.2026.season3.startDialogue.4: Then let’s try to hold on to everything that makes summer so bright! Let these sunny adventures stay with us a little longer!
6.Collection.2026.season4.startDialogue.0: Grandma, look at how the trees have changed! All those golden leaves with amber shades… autumn is working real magic!
6.Collection.2026.season4.startDialogue.1: Yes, my dear. Autumn is my favorite season. It’s like an artist painting the world in warm, cozy tones.
6.Collection.2026.season4.startDialogue.2: And every day brings something special — a scarlet leaf on the doorstep, the scent of apple pie, an evening by the fireplace...
6.Collection.2026.season4.startDialogue.3: You know, at my age, you really start to treasure these little joys. You want to remember every single one of them...
6.Collection.2026.season4.startDialogue.4: Then let’s gather them together! All those amber colors of autumn — let every special moment stay with us!
6.Collection.2026.season5.startDialogue.0: Lisa, can you feel it? Winter is almost here. The air’s so frosty it makes you want to wrap up in a scarf and sip hot chocolate!
6.Collection.2026.season5.startDialogue.1: Yeah, soon everything will be covered in snow, the lights will start glowing, and that special Christmas feeling will appear...
6.Collection.2026.season5.startDialogue.2: Exactly! You know, I’ve always loved this time — when winter is just beginning to promise miracles, and each day brings us closer to the holiday.
6.Collection.2026.season5.startDialogue.3: Sometimes the anticipation is even better than the celebration itself. There are so many little joys all around!
6.Collection.2026.season5.startDialogue.4: Then let’s not miss them! Let’s gather all those winter lights — from the very first frosty patterns to the Christmas decorations!

6.Merge2.BaseTutorial.dialogue: Here I am in Gardenridge! Time to meet up with Sofia — she should be at the art studio!
6.Merge2.BaseTutorial.dialogue_2: It’s weird though… why does everything around here look so… abandoned?
6.Merge2.BaseTutorial.dialogue_3: Lisa? What are you doing here?
6.Merge2.BaseTutorial.dialogue_4: Of course I came to visit my friend. Come on, show me your studio!
6.Merge2.BaseTutorial.dialogue_5: Um... I don’t have a studio anymore. I’ll be selling it to a developer — Voss&Vale.
6.Merge2.BaseTutorial.dialogue_6: I came to grab a few things. Help me find them? It’s a bit scary here alone…
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_0.step1: Without those boards, the window lets in so much more light. Now tell me, what happened to the studio? Why did you suddenly decide to sell it?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_0.step2: After my charity exhibition failed, I... stopped coming here. I couldn't bring myself to step inside.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_0.step3: This building is in such terrible shape... It might be easier to tear it down than restore it.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_0.step4: But this studio was your dream! Let’s fix this window, and you’ll see it come to life in new colors!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_1.step1: Yeah, it did come to life... though mostly in all the shades of dust we couldn't see before.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_1.step2: Dust is no big deal. Unlike these shabby walls - they're begging for a fresh coat of filler!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_1.step3: Lisa, I'm not sure it’s worth trying to fix anything...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_1.step4: Of course it is! We'll sort out these walls, and you'll tell me everything about that exhibition that made you give up on your dream.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_2.step1: I decided to hold a charity exhibition of my work. I spent so long preparing for it...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_2.step2: The day before the event, I hung all the paintings on display stands in the town square. And that night, someone vandalized them...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_2.step3: Officer Marcus tried to track down who did it, but the investigation went nowhere...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_2.step4: Oh, that’s awful. I’m sorry I wasn’t there for you back then... But I’ll do my best to help you now!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_3.step1: The walls look great! Just a few... dozen touches, and the studio will be good as new.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_3.step2: Maybe we should just take my things and leave... Let the next owner deal with the rest.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_3.step3: Let's be honest. What’s going on? Why are you so set on leaving this place and selling it?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_3.step4: I know, and I'm still not sure about it, it’s just... While I was gone, the place got haunted!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_3.step5: You mean by the ghosts of those poor dried-up plants in the corner? Then it’s time to exorcise them!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_4.step1: That’s one less ghost in the room. Soon, the spirits from beyond won’t bother you anymore!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_4.step2: No, I'm serious! At night, there are rustling and grinding sounds from here! I heard them with my own eyes! I mean— saw them with my own ears...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_4.step3: One sleepless night, I came to the studio... and heard chilling sounds at the door!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_4.step4: Hey, try not to worry. I’m sure it was just your imagination. Come on, let’s get back to cleaning.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_5.step1: Hopefully your worries will leave along with these old pots. There are no ghosts in existen...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_5.step2: Shh! Do you hear that? Those heavy footsteps! We've awakened the studio’s spirits!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_5.step3: Sofia? Lisa? Oh, so you're the ones making noise in here!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_5.step4: See? It’s Axel, not a ghost! I'm so glad you dropped by! Want to help us fix the shelves?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_6.step1: Lisa, you've only arrived in town and you're already stirring up all kinds of action!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_6.step2: Yep, I'm trying to help Sofia remove the ghosts... of the past, and bring her studio back to life.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_6.step3: I've been trying to get her to fix this place, but our dear Sofi kept brushing me off. Now that there are two of us, she won't stand a chance!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_6.step4: Fine, I give up! Let’s repair everything here. But if anything goes wrong, I’m backing out!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_7.step1: No shelf has ever withstood my hammer! You could put an elephant on this one now - it’d hold.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_7.step2: An elephant on a shelf sounds ambitious, but I trust you. You’ve always had magic hands.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_7.step3: That’s why I’m the hottest builder in Gardenridge. Want a five-story gazebo out back?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_7.step4: Ahem, maybe let’s work on the inside first, not outside... Like taking those boards off the door.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_8.step1: Brr... do you feel that? It’s like some otherworldly chill swept through...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_8.step2: It’s a draft sneaking in through the broken door. We'll fix it and remove that cold for good!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_9.step1: Your door is ready, ladies! It’ll survive about three hundred years of opening and closing. After that you might need to oil the hinges a bit.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_9.step2: Perfect, Axel! With you around, this studio’s makeover won't take long at all.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_9.step3: Yeah, thank you, guys. Maybe I really was worrying for no rea— Oh no! I definitely heard something scratching just now! Am I losing my mind?!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_9.step4: No, I heard that too... Pretty sure it came from behind those boxes. We’d better check it out!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_10.step1: All clear, no one here. Except... huh, there are some weird scratch marks on the floor. Sofia, did you adopt a stray tiger for your studio?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_10.step2: Not a tiger - a ghost! And I didn't adopt it, it moved in on its own!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_10.step3: Hmm, judging by these marks, there isn't one ghost... looks like there are several.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_10.step4: Ghosts, huh? Then let’s go hunt them down. Now, let’s see if anyone’s hiding in this cabinet!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_11.step1: The cabinet only had some empty chip bags and some bread crumbs. Looks like your ghosts were hungry.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_11.step2: What if... after the chips they decide to snack on us?!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_11.step3: Ghosts don't eat people. Besides, I'm still not convinced they even exist...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_11.step4: Then let’s look for ectoplasm or some other spooky clues and find out for sure! There’s gotta be something under those leaves on the floor!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_12.step1: No ectoplasm. Just something that looks like jam stains with bits of fur. Although... maybe that is what ectoplasm looks like?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_12.step2: I'm sure none of us knows enough about ghosts to tell whether they're here or not.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_12.step3: Please, details like that won’t stop me! I'll get to the truth - you watch!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_12.step4: No doubt about it, Axel. And while you hunt for the truth, mind replacing the old floorboards?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_13.step1: This new floor could withstand a tap-dancing troupe, let alone some puny ghosts!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_13.step2: Hey, show some respect! What if you make them angry?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_13.step3: Oh! Something hissed from behind that plant! The ghosts are upset!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_13.step4: Or maybe they're annoyed by that dried-up flower? Let’s remove it!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_14.step1: The ghosts did go quiet! I guess even otherworldly beings have a sense of beauty!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_14.step2: No wonder they settled in an art studio. Maybe they want to see it transformed too!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_14.step3: So I shouldn't have been afraid of disturbing their peace with the renovation....
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_14.step4: If ghosts enjoy repairs, then... wait, I’ve got an idea! But first, let’s replace this old table!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_15.step1: The new table is wonderful, Axel! But... what exactly did you come up with?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_15.step2: It’s simple — we’ll decorate the studio to win over our ghosts. And once they let their guard down, that’s when we'll catch them!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_15.step3: How exactly... I haven't figured out yet, but the plan is in development!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_15.step4: Then... let’s decorate the window with string lights. I’ve wanted to for so long!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_16.step1: The studio feels so much cozier... Maybe I shouldn’t sell it to Voss&Vale after all.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_16.step2: Wait, you were going to sell the studio? To those scoundrels?!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_16.step3: No one knows for sure if they’re villains or not. And besides... I thought I didn't have a choice...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_16.step4: Guys, instead of arguing, let’s focus on something nice — like putting up the decorations. And you can tell me all about Voss & Vale.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_17.step1: Voss&Vale showed up in town recently, looking to buy properties that weren’t making money.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_17.step2: After the recent flood, a lot of buildings were damaged, and their owners gladly accepted the offer and sold their places.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_17.step3: Yep. After that, Voss&Vale signs started popping up on every corner.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_17.step4: So that’s why the town started to feel... like these shelves. Bare and soulless. Let’s fill them up!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_18.step1: This is wonderful! I can feel the studio’s soul coming back. If only the same could happen to town...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_18.step2: You think the town has lost its soul?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_18.step3: I’m not sure if Voss & Vale are really to blame, but something in Gardenridge has changed. It feels like it’s losing its old charm...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_18.step4: Then let’s start by changing what we can. Let’s keep working on the studio!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_19.step1: I still can't believe Sofia wants to deal with Voss&Vale!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_19.step2: You think it’s that bad of an idea?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_19.step3: As bad as sticking your head into a T-rex’s mouth! Voss & Vale want to swallow Gardenridge whole — residents included, I'm sure of it!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_19.step4: There’s no evidence they’re criminals. Unlike us, if we let that poor door go curtainless!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_20.step1: Nice curtains, sure — but you can't use them to pull the truth over your eyes! Voss & Vale are playing their own game, and you know it!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_20.step2: Okay, Axel. What are you suggesting?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_20.step3: Step one: don’t sell your studio to those villains!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_20.step4: Let’s show Sophia, not tell her. Let’s make her studio feel cozy again and decorate the entrance!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_21.step1: The studio already looks better than it ever did before. It’s incredible!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_21.step2: Told you! No one would willingly give up a place this beautiful!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_21.step3: Unless they get evicted by ghosts... We still haven't solved that problem!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_21.step4: Leave that to me! I've already got an idea for how to catch them. I'll be gone for a bit — you two keep busy. Maybe lay down the rug!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_22.step1: Axel might have a future in interior design! The rug looks perfect on the floor!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_22.step2: I hope he’s as good at catching ghosts as he is at decorating...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_22.step3: Do you think they live into the studio?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_22.step4: I'm not sure... but someone’s definitely here. Oh, these thoughts make me nervous! I'll lay out my art supplies to calm down...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_23.step1: An artist’s tools appreciate being treated well. Every brush has a name so they would...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_23.step2: I’m back! And I’ve got a full ghost-hunting kit. I found an enchanted mirror trap!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_23.step3: Enchanted? Where did you even find that?!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_23.step4: I got the mirror from my attic. And I found the spell in Tamed Poltergeist magazine.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_23.step5: Don’t ask how I got the magazine, but... I read the spell and enchanted the mirror! Come on, we have to hang it up and get rid of those ghosts!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_24.step1: The mirror’s magic should start attracting... raccoons?! What the... where did they come from?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_24.step2: Looks like it wasn’t magic — just sunlight reflecting off the mirror. There were never any ghosts!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_24.step3: Raccoons broke into the empty studio and caused all this chaos! They only hid when we showed up!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_24.step4: Wait, those cute fluffballs were the ones scaring me? What do we even do with them now?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_24.step5: Axel will lure the raccoons back into the forest using my mirror and a few sunbeams, and we'll keep tidying up and set out the ceramics.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_25.step1: Oh, done with the pots already? I only just escaped the raccoons — they were so busy playing with the sunbeams they refused to let me leave!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_25.step2: I had to sacrifice my lunch to distract them - only then could I run out of the forest!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_25.step3: See? You handle raccoons as well as ghosts!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_25.step4: Now, ready to help us again? We need to craft a paper basket for Sofia!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_26.step1: What a wonderful basket! Finally my sketches won't go flying all over the studio while I'm working!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_26.step2: Oh? Did I hear that you're planning to keep creating in the studio after all?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_26.step3: You and Axel worked so hard to help bring my dream back to life. After that, I can't let you down!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_26.step4: I'm not selling the studio. No more self-pity, no more fear of failing again. Time to get it together! Though... I will need a stool for that.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_27.step1: I’m really glad you’re not dealing with Voss&Vale! I’d make you a dozen stools, easy!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_27.step2: Oh, you and Lisa have already done so much for me! I've realized there was only one ghost here all along — the ghost of my regrets and fears.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_27.step3: I hope we managed to banish it from your studio?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_27.step4: More than that — you got it out of my heart! I want to create again. Quick, I need an easel!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_28.step1: Sofia, this is wonderful! Gardenridge looks like it’s glowing on your canvas!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_28.step2: I tried to give back the soul it’s been losing... I hope it returns to the real town someday too.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_28.step3: You know... we managed to bring the studio’s soul back. Maybe we can do the same for town?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_28.step4: We could try restoring them before Voss & Vale buy everything out! I've only just found my home again — I don't want to lose it.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_28.step5: That’s a great idea! And I know exactly where to begin... Let’s check what’s left of the playroom.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_29.step1: These boards almost fell apart in my hands! Even the trash here is in terrible shape!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_29.step2: Exactly why we need to remove it as soon as possible!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_29.step3: So get a grip - and use those hands to grab the boxes. No time to rest!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_30.step1: All done, boss! Hey, what are you staring at so intently?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_30.step2: At that empty frame on the wall. Remember how it used to hold the arcade high-score board?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_30.step3: Of course I do! I was the champion! No one could beat my score in Pixel Muncher!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_30.step4: But you could never beat me in Cosmic Blaster! Too bad there’s nothing left of the board now... And that dusty old frame really needs to go.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_31.step1: The frame’s gone where it belongs! Off to the sidelines of old memories, making room for new ones!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_31.step2: It does feel more spacious without it. Which makes something else stand out a lot more now.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_31.step3: You mean the giant graffiti? Some teens clearly had fun here. And honestly, I see potential in it.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_31.step4: Oh yeah. And there’s also plenty of potential in sponges and cleaning solution.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_32.step1: For defeating the wall monster, Axel and Lisa earn two hundred points each! Great job!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_32.step2: I know how to boost the score. Take the boards off that window, and we could both hit a thousand!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_33.step1: And like that, we're back on top of the playroom leaderboard with our sco...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_33.step2: Everyone remain where you are. We’ve received a report of trespassing...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_33.step3: Axel and... Lisa?! What are you doing here?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_33.step4: Oh, hi, Markus. We're cleaning up the playroom. We were about to throw out an old machine...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_34.step1: So you’re clearing out the junk in here?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_34.step2: Yep! We want to give kids a place where they can hang out together again.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_34.step3: A good cause. Without the playroom, teenagers loiter outside and contribute to petty offenses...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_34.step4: So we're here to save our dear officer a few headaches! And we'll be done in no time — just like fixing that hole in the ceiling!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_35.step1: What you’re doing is commendable, but... it’s against the law. You don’t have the owner’s consent.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_35.step2: I got an anonymous tip about someone breaking into the playroom and making a racket. One more call like that, and I'll have to take you in.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_35.step3: Oh... we didn't think that through. So what do we do now? Do we have to leave everything like this?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_35.step4: No... I’ll try to get hold of the owner and make this official. Meanwhile, keep at it — that ladder in the corner looks ready for the trash!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_36.step1: Isn’t that complaint a bit odd? The moment we started repairing the playroom, someone filed it!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_36.step2: Maybe one of the neighbors thought some troublemakers broke in and decided to call the police?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_36.step3: Honestly, this feels a lot more like corporate interference than a vigilant neighbor.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_36.step4: You mean Voss&Vale? I know how we can find out for sure. You take care of the walls!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_37.step1: All set - the walls look brand new! Lisa, spill it. What’s this plan of yours?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_37.step2: I found an ad for a private investigator in the paper recently. If Voss & Vale are behind the complaint, we'll need evidence to prove it.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_37.step3: So now we’re calling a detective to chase those crooks with a magnifying glass?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_37.step4: Already did! Let everyone do what they do best. The detective investigates, and we repair the floor!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_38.step1: The high-strength concrete floor is ready to withstand an invasion of sneakers of all kinds!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_38.step2: So when is that detective finally showing up to start the investigation?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_38.step3: Patience, Axel. We have enough on our hands already. Let’s get those arcade machines set up!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_39.step1: Man, I really want to try these out! Maybe we can play a few games before the detective gets here?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_39.step2: I'm afraid you'll have to put that idea on hold. Good afternoon.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_39.step3: I've got the gist of your situation, so first I'll need to take a look around, if you don't mind.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_39.step4: Go ahead! We’ll keep working on the furniture. This room is definitely missing a sofa!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_40.step1: This is a great sofa! Cozy and comfortable... unlike the detective. He strikes me as pretty tough.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_40.step2: Wait, did you compare the detective to a couch?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_40.step3: I keep thinking about the investigation. Will the detective find any trace of Voss&Vale?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_40.step4: Relax and let him do his job. We need to distract you with something... Oh! Lay a rug on the floor!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_41.step1: You’ve gotten a lot done... Shame I never got to see the playroom before it fell into disrepair.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_41.step2: Oh no, I hope we didn't destroy any important evidence?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_41.step3: We may never know. But someone was watching the building — I found binoculars in the bushes nearby.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_41.step4: That’s incredible! Could you show them to us? Though it’s a bit dark in here to examine them properly. Let’s set up a floor lamp first.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_42.step1: Whoa, with proper lighting you can tell these binoculars are professional-grade!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_42.step2: Yes, they're not ordinary. You wouldn't find binoculars like these in a charity shop.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_42.step3: But it’s too early to draw any conclusions. I need to continue my search and inspect the building.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_42.step4: Alright. If you need our help, you'll find us here. We'll be putting a pouf in the playroom.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_43.step1: Phew, done. I can't believe someone was watching us. Who would even need that?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_43.step2: You don't need a crystal ball to see it! This has Voss&Vale written all over it - I'm sure of it!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_43.step3: Yikes... What if someone’s still watching us? I suddenly don’t feel very comfortable here...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_43.step4: Hey, cheer up! I know just the thing to distract you. Let’s turn on the arcade machines!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_44.step1: Told you - I'm unbeatable in Cosmic Blaster. Beat you again!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_44.step2: I admit it - you're a true champion. So, did the taste of victory help chase those worries away?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_44.step3: More than that — it fired me up! Now I’m determined to make this playroom absolutely perfect!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_44.step4: That’s what I like to hear! Alright, soldier, let’s get to work. Time to put up some posters!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_45.step1: These posters make me feel like a kid again — all set to ditch homework and hang out at the arcade with friends all night!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_45.step2: Oh, I know what’ll take you even further back. Neon signs on the wall!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_46.step1: Hey, these signs look exactly like the ones from the old arcade! Where did you find them?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_46.step2: They were in the boxes near the exit. They looked practically new, so I hung them back up.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_46.step3: My inspection is complete. And those boxes contained something rather curious — a brand-new TV.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_46.step4: Could you plug it in? it’s worth taking a closer look.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_47.step1: This TV still has its factory seals on it. It clearly appeared here after the flood.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_47.step2: Maybe the owner bought it for the renovation, but never followed through?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_47.step3: Possible. But I also found some documents that need a closer look. I'll need a small table to lay them out.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_48.step1: Alright, repair estimates, receipts... All of them are recent, yet none mention a specific person...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_48.step2: There are also recent signs of tampering with the utility panels and mar outside the building.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_48.step3: I don't understand - what does all of this mean?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_48.step4: Someone expected to own this building and had renovation plans. You got in their way.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_48.step5: Yeah, and we're not backing off! I'll get the lighting sorted now.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_49.step1: Detective, is there anything that points to who started all this? Or who was watching us?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_49.step2: I know who you mean, but the evidence is circumstantial. Legally, I can’t move against Voss&Vale...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_49.step3: I intend to keep pursuing this matter. If you notice any further suspicious activity...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_49.step4: We'll definitely let you know. Thanks for your help, Detective. And we'll keep working — there are still some pillows to put out...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_50.step1: I can't believe Voss&Vale are going to get away with this! It’s obviously all their doing!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_50.step2: No proof, no case. Now we just have to hope their complaints won’t come back to bite us.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_50.step3: Until Marcus comes back with an answer about the repair permit, how about we plug in the console?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_50.step4: Just don't expect to beat me as easily as you did in Cosmic Blaster! Come on — time to grab the controllers!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_51.step1: Having fun, kids? I see you’ve already finished renovating the playroom - impressive.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_51.step2: Markus! So, did you manage to get everything officially approved?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_51.step3: You bet. The owner was more than happy to hear you took on the playroom as a volunteer project.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_51.step4: What’s more - if you're up for continuing to restore town... I've got another place for you.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_51.step5: The veterinary clinic. An unpleasant incident forced it to close years ago... but now there’s hope of bringing it back. You should go there at once!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_52.step1: Much better without the draft. Axel, do you know what happened here? Was it the flood again?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_52.step2: Not just that. There was a scandal at the clinic when we were kids. I don’t remember the details.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_52.step3: Yeah, that rings a bell... But who cares about the past? Let’s focus on what comes next!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_52.step4: And I can already predict it - in the very near future, we’ll restore all the plaster on that wall!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_53.step1: Wow, what a difference! With the walls all fixed up, it already feels much nicer in here!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_53.step3: Bob, my man, long time no see! Decided to join our renovation crew? No problem - we’re always open!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_53.step4: Axel’s right. Come give us a hand with this lamp. You know your way around wiring better than we do.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_54.step1: Great job, Bob! You’ve always been good with tech. We’re lucky you showed up.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_54.step2: I was passing by and saw you and Markus. Figured I’d stop in.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_54.step3: That’s the right call! Now you get to pitch in and help restore town too!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_54.step4: Yeah, I’d like that. I’ll help you fix the cabinets.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_55.step1: Bob, with you around, things are definitely moving faster! Though at first, I honestly thought this place was completely hopeless...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_55.step2: By the way, do you know what happened to the clinic? Care to tell us?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_55.step3: Uh, well... how about we remove that old board from the wall first?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_56.step1: The cork board’s gone. But don’t think we’re giving up on getting that story out of you — you clearly know something.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_56.step2: I’m fuzzy on the details. But one night, all the animals staying at the clinic got out.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_56.step3: It caused a huge scandal. All the animals were found, but the clinic’s reputation took a hit.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_56.step4: Well, that explains why the couch looks like a hundred clawed paws ran across it. Let’s see if we can make it look presentable again...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_57.step1: The sofa looks good as new! But I still can’t figure out how all those animals got out.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_57.step3: Okay, let’s stop poking at the past. It’s old and nasty — just like that plant in the corner! Time to get rid of it and forget about it.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_58.step1: Yikes! Bugs crawled all over me when I picked up that pot! Good riddance to that dried-up thing!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_58.step2: Hey, you’re still afraid of insects? Just like when we were kids?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_58.step3: I’m not afraid of them! It just caught me off guard... and anyway, no time to chat! Bob and I still have a whole pile of boxes to carry out!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_59.step1: That’s all the boxes. What’s next?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_59.step2: Oh, Bob, you work so fast I can barely keep up with coming up with tasks...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_59.step3: Don’t worry, Lisa - I’ve got tasks covered. While we were hauling boxes, I tripped ten times!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_59.step4: It’s time for some hammer-and-nail therapy. These holes and dents aren’t fixing themselves!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_60.step1: And that’s it - not a single crack left in the floor! Now we can...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_60.step2: Achoo! Oh, sorry, I’ve got... A-a-choo! My allergies are acting up...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_60.step3: It seems our work disturbed pollen from the dried flowers. We should clear them away.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_61.step1: How is it now? Bob, can you breathe easier?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_61.step2: Yeah, thanks. I’m ready to keep going. What’s next?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_61.step3: Maybe we should split the waiting area from the exam room. A partition ought to do the trick.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_62.step1: Looks perfect! Now it’s time to focus on the technical setup of the exam room!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_62.step2: Oh, that’s right up our strongman’s alley! Bob, where do you think we should start?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_62.step3: I’d say... we should install the X-ray machine.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_63.step1: Wonderful! High-quality equipment like this will help the clinic earn people’s trust quickly.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_63.step3: Then let’s keep going — we still have plenty of equipment to set up!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_64.step1: Wow, look at all this high-tech gear! We could open the clinic now!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_64.step2: Not yet. We’re missing a proper examination table.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_64.step3: Right! How did I forget that? Let’s set it up now!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_65.step1: I’ve set up a special mechanism in the table so it’s more comfortable for vets to examine pets.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_65.step2: You care so much about the staff and the animals... Maybe you should've been a vet!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_65.step3: I have... allergies to animals. Being a vet wouldn’t work for me...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_65.step4: Don’t pressure him! That could be a sore spot for Bob. Go put up the information boards instead!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_66.step1: Done. And I wasn’t trying to upset Bob, honestly! I just asked about being a veterinarian...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_66.step2: There’s another reason I can’t be a vet — guilt. I think it’s finally time I came clean...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_66.step3: If there’s something you want to share, Axel and I are always ready to listen.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_66.step4: Thank you. I think I’ll sit down first. Oh—and could I get a cushion? When I’m nervous, I always need to hold something soft.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_67.step1: the truth is, the clinic closed because of me.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_67.step2: How could that be? You were a kid back then!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_67.step3: I loved animals despite my allergies. But I was scared of doctors as a kid, so I thought the animals here were being... mistreated.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_67.step4: I once hid behind the plant in the corner... Actually, it looked nice there. Maybe we should put a new one in its place?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_68.step1: See how the plant covers that corner? Nobody noticed me, and the clinic closed for the night.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_68.step2: I came out of hiding, opened the doors from inside, and let all the animals go. I thought I was doing the right thing — saving them.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_68.step3: Oh, Bob... you were some boy who thought he was doing the right thing. Don’t blame yourself...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_68.step4: Let’s lay a rug on the floor, okay? Take a break from the story and try to calm down a bit.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_69.step1: This rug reminds me of the old clinic. Back before it closed... because of me.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_69.step2: So when I saw you renovating the place... I knew I had to help however I could, to make up for what I did.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_69.step3: Forget the past. What matters is who you are today. And today, you’re trying to fix things!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_69.step4: Thanks to you, the clinic will bloom again like— actually, hold on, I’ll add some flowers to...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_70.step1: These are hypoallergenic flowers grown by my grandmother. No need to worry about your allergies!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_70.step2: Thanks, but I took an allergy pill just in case. The thing is... I recently found a stray kitten.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_70.step3: I couldn’t take him home because of my allergies, so I just fed him. But maybe we could give him a home here? What do you think?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_70.step4: That’s a wonderful idea! Then we should get some treats ready for our fluffy friend!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_71.step1: Huh, not a single cat in sight. Maybe we picked food he doesn’t like?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_71.step2: I tried to bring Ginger inside, but he hissed at the door and ran into the bushes.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_71.step3: Ginger? That’s a very telling name... Maybe he got scared by something?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_71.step4: Yeah, Bob, could you check the building for any scary noises or anything like that? Axel and I will hang up the visitor log in the meantime.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_72.step1: Alright, the log is up — but Bob’s still not back. Think the ghosts from Sofia’s studio moved in here, and now he’s hunting them?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_72.step2: I doubt it — he’s probably just checking everything carefully. Since he’s not back yet, let’s install the info display on the partition.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_73.step1: The sign’s up, and Bob’s back! We were starting to worry. Any idea what scared the cat?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_73.step2: I found a strange device next to a drainpipe. Spent ages trying to figure out what it was.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_73.step3: A device? Huh. And what did it turn out to be?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_73.step4: An ultrasonic repeller. Animals find the sound unpleasant, so they try to stay away from it.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_73.step5: That explains why Ginger wouldn’t go inside! Bob, please get rid of that thing quickly, and we’ll prepare a carrier for the kitty.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_74.step1: Well, the repeller’s gone now, and Ginger can relax. But where did that thing come from?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_74.step2: Someone’s trying to sabotage our restoration efforts again. If we hadn’t found that repeller...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_74.step3: The clinic would have reopened... but the animals wouldn’t enter. No patients means it’d close again.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_74.step4: And Voss&Vale would’ve been able to buy the building... Well, not anymore! Ginger will prove it — it’s time to invite him back inside!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_75.step1: That’s wonderful! Thanks to you, Bob, the clinic gets a fresh start and the kitten found a home!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_75.step2: Until the staff arrives, I’ll keep coming by to take care of Ginger. And even after that...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_75.step3: Wow, you’ve done an amazing job here! Absolutely top-notch!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_75.step4: Well, look who it is - Tony! The best taxi driver in all of town! What brings you here?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_75.step5: I was looking for a cozy spot to eat lunch. Instead, I found an outstanding renovation crew!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_75.step6: People say you volunteer your time restoring places... then I insist you come see the garden with me!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_76.step1: Nice work, Axel! The future flowers in the greenhouse will need plenty of light, so fixing up the windows was the right place to start.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_76.step2: Plenty of light, huh... Then let’s take care of the glass dome next — even the brightest sunbeams won't make it through all that grime!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_77.step1: You two are doing great! I wouldn’t have managed even half this much by myself.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_77.step2: Wow, Tony, you tried fixing up the greenhouse by yourself?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_77.step3: Yeah, I did. I used to come here during breaks between rides — it was quiet and cozy back then... So I wanted to do something, at least.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_77.step4: I cleaned up some trash and set out buckets for the leaks. Speaking of which, let’s remove this one.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_78.step1: All done — the bucket’s gone! I did manage to spill a bit of water on one pant leg, though... but I'm hoping it'll dry soon.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_78.step2: Or you can keep up the water treatments and soak the other leg too! Because now we're going to wash the dirt off the ceiling!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_79.step1: Look, Lisa - the ceiling’s sparkling now! And I didn’t even get myself wet!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_79.step2: Don't get your hopes up too high. We still need to clean the walls of old wallpaper and graffiti. The threat of wet pants isn’t over yet!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_80.step1: Phew, I didn't realize scrubbing walls with a sponge counts as a workout. I'm actually a bit tired...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_80.step2: Hey, Tony, how about you handle the planting instead? I could use a break.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_80.step3: I tried growing plants here once. Even with local fertilizer, every seedling withered away.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_80.step4: Okay, okay, I was just kidding. Besides, it’s too early for planting — we’ve got tons of other work. Just look at that floor, it’s begging for repairs!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_81.step1: Ouch! Those boxes by the wall almost took me down! What’s inside, bricks?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_81.step2: No, it’s the same fertilizer I used. Somehow it survived the flood in the greenhouse.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_81.step3: Hmm, that’s strange... The boxes do say “fertilizer,” but I'm sure they're pesticides.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_81.step4: My grandmother used the same kind to deal with pests. I think we should get rid of these boxes.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_82.step1: That’s why I couldn’t grow anything! I was feeding my flowers pesticides instead of fertilizer!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_82.step2: Seems like someone wanted this to happen. The labels were faked on purpose...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_82.step3: If someone tried to restore the place, it'd make sense to use the local “fertilizer” — after all, the greenhouse used to bloom with it.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_82.step4: I'd put money on Voss&Vale! They messed with this place too — I'm furious! Ugh, I'm going to toss out that chair. I need to blow off some steam!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_83.step1: Hey, Tony, do you know if anyone besides you has been around the greenhouse lately?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_83.step2: I don’t think so. No one has come here in a long time. Why would anyone want a half-ruined building?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_83.step3: Looks like someone did. While I was dealing with the chair, I noticed footprints other than ours.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_83.step4: They could be anyone’s. It’s not like the footprints say Voss&Vale. Let’s finish the cleanup — the old boards still need to go.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_84.step1: Ha! I inspected the building and found the same mar the detective showed us at the playroom!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_84.step2: Incredible! That means Voss&Vale were planning to get their hands on the greenhouse as well...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_84.step3: Yeah, well, we've ruined their nasty plans again! They have no idea who they're messing with!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_84.step4: Let’s keep working. It’s time for some furniture — a small dresser would fit perfectly here.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_85.step1: Looks solid. Just like our confidence in taking on Voss&Vale!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_85.step2: Voss&Vale... So that’s who you mean! I’ve run into some of their drivers a couple of times...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_85.step3: I tried talking to them at a gas station, but they got rude when I asked about their work.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_85.step4: The more we learn about Voss&Vale, the more suspicious they get. Food for thought... Anyway, back to the renovation — let’s hang the shelves!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_86.step1: These shelves look right at home here! They’re going to look amazing covered in flowers.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_86.step2: I’m not as imaginative as you are, but I think so too. So then... shall we get to the plants?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_86.step3: Not yet, it’s still too early for that. Right now, let’s set up a small relaxation area!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_87.step1: Wow, that bench looks so inviting. I could sit there and relax for hours after a day like this!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_87.step2: Then why not take a break? You’ve earned it. You’ve been helping me every step of the way...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_87.step3: I’d do anything for you! I mean... for the town! Right. Anyway, I can rest later. What’s next?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_87.step4: Alright then, Axel — if you're still full of energy... let’s add a chair in the corner. More seating wouldn't hurt!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_88.step1: Wow, the greenhouse is really coming together! Now imagine it filled with blooming flowers...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_88.step2: No need to imagine - it’s time for this place to bloom again!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_88.step3: And we'll have help from the best plant expert there is... Let’s get ready for her arrival and start placing the first flowers!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_89.step1: Oh, Lisa, how delightful! Your hard work has brought warmth back to this place. My heart ached thinking the greenhouse might never bloom again...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_89.step2: Gloria?! So that's our gardening expert! How did I not realize that now?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_89.step3: Grandma knows all about flowers and has agreed to help. So, how do we bring the garden back to life?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_89.step4: First, let’s bring in a watering can - flowers love being cared for right on time!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_90.step1: The watering can is here! Now we’re ready to keep learning the finer points of gardening!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_90.step2: Sorry, but I'll have to skip this lesson. My break’s run long — time to get back on the road and drive passengers around Gardenridge!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_90.step3: Of course, Tony, get back to work! But first, have a refreshing lemonade with us for the road — I brought some along from the café!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_91.step1: Thanks for the great drink! And for fixing up the greenhouse — it’s clear it’ll be better soon. I've got to get back behind the wheel!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_91.step2: We're always happy to help town - no need to thank us. Good luck, Tony! Drive safely!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_91.step3: Grandma, back to our flowers. How about placing a bouquet on the table?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_91.step4: One bouquet? Dear, that’s not enough. Add flowers to the windows — then it’ll be beautiful!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_92.step1: Wow, Grandma! Your flowers always look so beautiful. What’s your secret?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_92.step2: A bit of care, a touch of love... and even the smallest sprout will bloom beautifully!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_92.step3: I picked up a pretty scraggly plant not long ago, and now it looks amazing. Let’s set it by the wall — that spot suits it best.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_93.step1: Wow, Gloria! You’ve transformed this greenhouse into a true enchanted garden!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_93.step2: Thank you, dear, but we’re not done yet. And we’re going to need your muscles for this one.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_93.step3: Right in the center, we'll plant... a lemon tree! It will become the greenhouse’s main feature. Come along, Axel — I know where to find a sapling.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_94.step1: Gloria, when you said it would be a “sapling,” I imagined something... smaller.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_94.step2: Seedlings come in all kinds. But now it’s a symbol of sunshine and the greenhouse’s new life!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_94.step3: Oh! I just noticed a kitty watching us through the window! Looks like he wants to admire our tree too. Shall we let him inside?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_95.step1: What a cutie! I think he likes the new greenhouse. He can’t stop looking at the flowers!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_95.step2: And he’s not alone. This place is unbelievable. I've never seen anything so beautiful... well, as far as buildings go!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_95.step3: Still, we're missing one final touch. Let’s add a drop of true magic... and release fluttering butterflies into our garden!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_96.step1: It’s so beautiful! Grandma, thank you for helping us bring the greenhouse back to life!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_96.step2: My dear, you know you can always count on me! Besides, I'm happy to do my part in restoring Gardenridge.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_96.step3: You're still here! I didn't even recognize the greenhouse from afar — it’s changed that much... Oh! That’s not why I came!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_96.step4: Lisa! Gloria! You need to get back to the café now! It’s a disaster... the café has been destroyed!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_97.step1: It’s a start! We’ll clean this place up, make the repairs, and the café will be good as new!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_97.step2: I don’t know, dear... Maybe it’s time to accept it. To let the café go and stop clinging to memories...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_97.step3: Man, you two move fast! I barely caught up. They filled me in already — just tell me where to start!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_97.step4: That’s what I like to hear! Give us a hand hauling out the ruined furniture. It’s beyond saving.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_98.step1: I can’t believe it. The café was ruined in a matter of hours, and only when none of us were here...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_98.step2: Markus, could you tell us more about what happened? I’d like to look over the documents — I can't shake the feeling that something’s off.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_98.step3: I can’t legally share this information, but... I’ll make an exception and prepare the documents.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_98.step4: Thank you - that means a lot to us. And ... we'll keep working on the repairs.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_99.step1: Your humble servant has cleared away all those sorry piles of wood that once passed for furniture!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_99.step2: Grandpa Richard and I picked those "planks" together... but now they really belong in a landfill.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_99.step3: But it’s a chance to freshen up the interior, right? Change can be a reason to make life better!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_99.step4: You know, dear... I've been holding onto things too much. Memories live in the heart, not in objects. Well... the flower pots should go as well.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_100.step1: Oh no, I think I spilled some soil from the flower pots all over myself... Lisa, do you happen to have a couple of wet wipes?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_100.step2: Nope, but don't worry — we'll clean you up anyway. We're about to wash the walls, so we can give your outfit a nice wet cleanup too!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_101.step1: Ouch! Lisa, did you hit me? Do you think I cleaned the walls that badly?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_101.step2: Hey, I didn’t do anything! A piece of plaster fell on you from the ceiling!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_101.step3: Yeah, the ceiling’s definitely seen better days. Alright, I'll fix it real quick before something worse drops on our heads.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_102.step1: What a transformation! Looking at this place now, you’d think nothing had ever happened.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_102.step2: Yeah. The only signs of the disaster are the broken windows and that draft coming through the holes.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_102.step3: That’s no problem at all. We'll just replace the glass — and the wind won't dare wander in uninvited anymore. The windows will be good as new!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_103.step1: While I was glazing the windows, I got a big idea. But I’ll need a lot of tools for it...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_103.step2: And the tools on the table won't work for your big idea?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_103.step3: They got soaked and gave up on life... I know — I'll swing by my place to grab my tools and toss these on the way.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_104.step1: So, Axel, are you finally going to share your big idea? Grandma and I are dying of curiosity!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_104.step2: I propose we build... a glass dome in the roof! The café will get so much more natural light!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_104.step3: It sounds nice, but I'm not sure Grandma will agree to such a big change...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_104.step4: Axel’s idea is simply wonderful, dear! Lately I've felt the café’s been a bit too dark, so a glass dome would be just perfect!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_105.step1: The dome lets in so much sunlight! The whole place feels bigger and brighter already.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_105.step2: You're right, Axel - your idea was amazing! How did you even come up with it?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_105.step3: The greenhouse gave me the inspiration. But that’s not where my good ideas end! Sunlight is great, of course...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_105.step4: Still, we’ll need electric lights once evening comes. I’ll go hang the lamps!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_106.step1: Oh, Lisa, I heard about what happened and ran here now! Is there anything I can do to help?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_106.step2: Yes! Grandma’s upset about the accident and could use some support while we repair the café.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_106.step3: Of course! I'll stay with Gloria and keep her spirits up. And I brought a couple of my paintings — maybe you can use them for decoration?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_106.step4: Of course! The flood ruined the old paintings anyway. I’ll swap them out for your artwork right now!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_107.step1: Sophia is an incredible artist! Axel, just look at how her paintings have transformed the café!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_107.step2: Yeah, our dear old Sofi is a true master. Just looking at her art got me feeling inspired myself!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_107.step3: Oh? And what exactly did that inspiration inspire you to do?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_107.step4: To bring in some sofas! Our future customers probably won’t want to sit on the floor!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_108.step1: I was at the precinct and heard about the accident. I picked up the case documents. Is that alright?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_108.step2: Of course! The café incident struck me as suspicious... Was there anything interesting in the files?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_108.step3: The contractor responsible for the accident is is connected to Voss&Vale. I suspect they're involved — I just need to dig deeper.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_108.step4: I knew something was off! Please keep looking into the documents, and I'll get back to the repairs — we need to set up a dessert display case.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_109.step1: The aroma of desserts were distracting, but I still found inconsistencies in the documents.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_109.step2: The emergency repairs were rushed and done without notifying the café owners.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_109.step3: Looks like Voss&Vale wanted to rush everything while we were away. Those scoundrels!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_109.step4: Their contractor has come up in other cases involving accidents during emergency repairs around the city. I'm going to examine them closely.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_109.step5: Alright, we’ll wait and see what you uncover. Meanwhile, I’ve got tables to arrange.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_110.step1: That’s better! Our future customers finally have somewhere to sit. We’re almost ready to reopen!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_110.step2: I came to help too. I figured your coffee machine didn’t survive the flood, so I brought a new one.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_110.step3: I've upgraded it a bit... now the coffee will always come out perfect.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_110.step4: I can't wait to try it! Let’s get the coffee machine set up where it belongs!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_111.step1: Mmm, the coffee smells and tastes incredible! I don't know what you did to the machine, but I'm sure this is a whole new word in technology!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_111.step2: You're flattering me. I just... tweaked the settings a little.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_111.step3: I've got another call to get to. Is there anything else I can help with?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_111.step4: No worries, we’re almost done. I can take care of the coffee bean shelves myself!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_112.step1: All set! These shelves would survive ten floods and still stay put - I guarantee it!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_112.step2: Let’s hope we won't have to test that. I'll take your word for it!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_112.step3: Oh, my dears, you've done the impossible! Our family café is back on its feet - all thanks to you.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_112.step4: Now I see I was too quick to lose hope. You know what — it’s time I did my part in restoring the café too! I want to decorate it with flowers!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_113.step1: Grandma, it’s beautiful! I hope the renewed café will make you as happy as the old one did!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_113.step2: Of course, dear - like you said: Change can be a reason to make life better!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_113.step3: I’ll get started right away. But firs I should pick up some fresh fruit for the future customers!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_114.step1: Looks like the café is finished. If that's the case, I have another place I'd like to show you.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_114.step2: And where would that be? Is this connected to the investigation? Are we going to take on Voss&Vale?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_114.step3: Not yet. The evidence isn't strong enough. But I traced their next target — their contractors are circling the museum.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_114.step4: These scoundrels are targeting the museum? Are they trying to wipe out Gardenridge’s history next? We can't let that happen, Lisa — let’s go!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_115.step1: I threw the box away. Out of all our renovations, that was the easiest task ever... So what’s next?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_115.step2: Waiting. I called Markus - he said he’d be here soon and asked us not to touch anything.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_115.step3: Then, with your permission, I’ll take my leave. Unfortunately, Voss&Vale aren’t my only concern.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_115.step4: Of course, of course, we’ll manage just fine. For now, we’ll throw out that old crate with the flower — I doubt Markus will mind.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_116.step1: Achoo! A-a-choo! Whew, that box kicked up much dust... We need to do something about it!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_116.step2: Careful! That’s premium antique dust. Are you trying to throw away a priceless artifact?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_116.step3: Uh... no, of course not! We’ll carefully collect it in a jar, give it to the museum staff, and...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_116.step4: Relax, I’m kidding! That dust is just old soil from a flowerpot. If we remove the dried plant, it’ll be much easier to breathe!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_117.step1: Sorry for the wait! I’ve got the permit with me. You’re officially authorized to restore the museum!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_117.step2: Markus, that’s great news! So we can get to work without any issues?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_117.step3: Ahem... not quite. You need to prove the museum’s cultural value — otherwise, it goes to auction after being closed for so long.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_117.step4: You’ll need to restore it as quickly as possible if you want to save it — the auction is coming up soon. So get rid of those boxes and get to work!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_118.step1: Hey, I found a note! "What we hid awaits its hour. Only the observant will discover the way."
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_118.step2: Could it be... treasure? Remember the rumors about a hidden Gardenridge treasure in the museum?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_118.step3: Sure. I also remember the rumor that our school principal was an alien who fed on ink. So not everything should be believed.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_118.step4: You heard Markus — no time to overthink this. We’ve got to fix the museum quickly. Let’s toss those old frames off the wall first.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_119.step1: When I feel this much pressure, it gets harder to think. I have no idea what to start with!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_119.step2: Don’t worry, Lisa. You just need to get back in the groove. Leave the next task to me!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_119.step3: I suggest we start restoring the columns. Give them a bit more time, and they won’t be able to hold the ceiling anymore...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_120.step1: I’m getting drawn into this renovation process! Axel, thank you much for your support!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_120.step2: I’m always happy to help you with anything, you know that! So, ready to take the reins of our repair crew?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_120.step3: Definitely! Since we're fixing columns anyway, let's take care of the giant one in the center.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_121.step1: There has to be a treasure. A faded map was hidden beneath the plaster, and almost worn away, but...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_121.step2: I’m sure it looks like a museum floor plan! It must show how to find the treasure. I redrew everything I could, take a look!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_121.step3: Let me see! Ugh, the lighting here is awful — I can barely make out the map. Let’s fix the ceiling so it finally gets brighter in here!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_122.step1: At least it’s brighter now. Still, the map remains a mystery. It seems incomplete somehow...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_122.step2: Exactly! There are no marks showing where the treasure is hidden. So how are we supposed to find it?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_122.step3: Maybe... there’s a second part of the map somewhere? Also hidden in the museum?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_122.step4: Good idea. If we found one part during renovations, we might find the other the same way. Let’s fix the stairs and see what turns up!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_123.step1: Ugh. I searched every step and found absolutely nothing. Looks like there’s no treasure for us...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_123.step2: But you built a great staircase! And nobody said treasure hunting was easy — don’t give up just yet!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_123.step3: Let’s move on to repairing the walls - maybe they’re hiding the second part of the map!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_124.step1: Lisa, we found it! We found the second part of the map! I sketched everything onto a separate sheet!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_124.step2: A plane, a dinosaur, and a bunch of random drawings... What do they have to do with the map?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_124.step3: I honestly don’t know yet... Maybe it’s a riddle? Or unknown hieroglyphs? Or someone’s illustrations?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_124.step4: We can’t afford to get distracted. Restoring the museum is more important than chasing treasure. Time to fix the floor — the map can wait!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_125.step1: I think I’ve got it! While lining up the floor tiles, I suddenly thought — what if we overlay the two maps and match them up?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_125.step2: Now these are images placed in specific spots in the exhibition hall... I get it — they’re exhibits!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_125.step3: So the map is a layout of the exhibits? Then where does the treasure come into play?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_125.step4: We need to find the correct order! Only one exhibit is marked as number one — the painting. Let’s hang it and see what happens!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_126.step1: The first exhibit is in place! What could it mean? That the treasure is hidden in some kind of knight’s castle? Huh... do we even have castles near Gardenridge?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_126.step2: Easy there! Let’s study the painting first... See that? There’s a note tucked behind the frame!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_126.step3: "Without it, a warrior is vulnerable." Without what? The painting? Are we supposed to fight with it?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_126.step4: This is a museum, not a boxing ring! The answer must be the exhibit that goes second... and I’m sure it’s the shield!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_127.step1: When we hung up the shield, I clearly heard a click! Looks like we triggered some kind of mechanism... It’s got to be connected to the treasure!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_127.step2: So we were right! Arrange all the exhibits correctly, and we'll unlock the hidden treasure cache!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_127.step3: Now we need to find the next clue. It must be hidden inside the shield. I'll find it in no time...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_127.step4: Then you search for the next riddle, and I’ll arrange the museum catalogs. I found them in the exhibit basement — they deserve some fresh air!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_128.step1: The catalogs are sorted alphabetically now. It'll be much easier for visitors to navigate them.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_128.step2: And I've got the next clue! "It travels above the clouds..." Come on, that's obvious. An airplane!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_128.step3: Alright then, let’s place the airplane and see if you’re right!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_129.step1: That click was music to my ears. Now I'm ready to crack museum riddles like nuts! Where's the next clue...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_129.step2: Here you go. The clue was hidden behind the airplane propeller. "It changes the one who wears it."
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_129.step3: Maybe I'm not the genius I took myself for... The gears are grinding, but no ideas are coming out!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_129.step4: Then I’ll take the smart role this time. Our next exhibit is the mask!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_130.step1: Mask? Check. Click? Check. Looks like we solved it again! Shall we keep going?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_130.step2: I've been studying the map, and I think one of the exhibits is sitting on a sort of platform...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_130.step3: And right now, there’s no podium in the hall! Without it, we won’t be able to properly place an exhibit and trigger the hidden mechanism!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_130.step4: Good catch... Let’s take a break from the riddles and install the podium first!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_131.step1: Ta-da - a brand-new podium for our museum! You can put anything on it, however you want!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_131.step2: We can’t just guess. We have to follow the map. But first, I want to do something...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_131.step3: This place seriously needs some greenery! Let’s put a plant here, then get back to our riddles!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_132.step1: Your designer taste has been satisfied — now it’s time to satisfy my treasure-hunter thirst! Let the mask reveal its secrets!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_132.step2: "A clay vessel." Hm, concise. I’m guessing it means a vase."
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_132.step3: Only one way to find out - let’s put the vase where it belongs!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_133.step1: The museum is coming back to life! At this rate, we'll get everything ready before the auction.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_133.step2: Then we don’t slow down - and we get back to our riddles. I found another clue inside the vase!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_133.step3: "A trace of the past..." Hm, what could that mean? Every exhibit here is a trace of the past! So which one do we need?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_133.step4: Let’s take it literally - we’ll install the dinosaur footprint cast!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_134.step1: Unbelievable... how old are town’s lands, if our museum even has a cast of a dinosaur footprint?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_134.step2: Very old... That’s exactly why we have to save the museum and prove its cultural value — so those Voss&Vale scoundrels don’t get it!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_134.step3: Don’t worry, Axel! Plenty of visitors will walk through this hall again - we’ll make sure of it!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_134.step4: Oh! I just realized — the museum needs a curator too, not just visitors! Let’s set up a spot and place a comfy stool!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_135.step1: This stool looks so comfy, I might even want to work here as the curator someday!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_135.step2: If you want to, sure, you can try. But, your skills are needed elsewhere!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_135.step3: There’s a new clue on the back of the cast: "A Stone Age tool." What do you think, Axel? Tools are kind of your thing!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_135.step4: I’m sure it’s what I have in common with ancient people — a hammer! Mine’s metal, theirs was stone. I’ll bring it over!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_136.step1: Oof... this ancient hammer is heavier than my work hammer. I need a quick break...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_136.step2: While you rest, let your brain do the work. There was another clue tied to the hammer’s handle!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_136.step3: "The ground trembled beneath it." The only thing I can think of is my old diesel generator at home — it shakes the whole yard when it starts!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_136.step4: I think the answer should be something massive. The kind of thing we built that podium for... let's put a dinosaur skeleton on it!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_137.step1: What a beast! No way... did real T-rexes live in town once?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_137.step2: I think it was brought here from elsewhere... Though we know very little about the first settlers.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_137.step3: The archives from that era have been considered lost for years now. It’s a shame — they’re the true cultural heritage of Gardenridge...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_137.step4: We’ll prove that value with the exhibits we already have. They valuable too — which is exactly why we should put a barrier around the dinosaur!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_138.step1: Now no one will get too close to the dinosaur. Unless they enjoy breaking the rules...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_138.step2: Well, I ended up breaking the rules myself... and found our next clue in the T. rex's mouth!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_138.step3: I won’t be mad if you can solve it! "The final guardian..." Once we get past it, the stash should open! But who could it be?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_138.step4: I’ve got an idea... Let’s place the knight’s armor in the exhibition hall!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_139.step1: The floor opened up behind the armor, and what do we find? Papers, old photos, and a hat?!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_139.step2: These are the archives of Gardenridge’s first settlers! Documents, letters, photographs — everything! And a note: "True wealth lives in memory."
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_139.step3: We found the real treasure! These archives will help prove the museum's cultural value and save it!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_139.step4: So that hat belonged to Gardenridge’s founders? That kind of exhibit shouldn’t sit in a dusty hideout — it belongs out in the open!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_140.step1: I’d wear a hat like that with pride! What are the odds it belonged to my great-great-great-grandpa and I can keep it?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_140.step2: Wardrobe upgrade can wait. The auction’s soon - how’s it going, you two?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_140.step3: We restored the museum and found the first settlers’ archives — they’ll help prove the museum’s cultural value to the city, fast!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_140.step4: I’ll pack the documents into my backpack, and you can deliver them to City Hall!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_141.step1: Unbelievable! You did it again. Voss&Vale won't be getting their hands on this part of town!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_141.step2: For town, we’ll do anything, Markus - you know that! I can’t wait to tackle something new!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_141.step3: Then I have a new task for you. The mayor needs help with a winter fair in Gardenridge. Interested? I’ll explain everything there.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_141.step4: Organize a fair? Sure, why not! Time to finally take a break from Voss&Vale’s schemes and do something else!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_142.step1: Well, that’s a start! Now we need to figure out what to fix first. Axel, what do you think?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_142.step2: Fix this place? Come on, it's falling apart! We'd be better off rebuilding it from the ground up!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_142.step3: That's right. The fairground buildings were declared unsafe years ago. They need to go!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_142.step4: Fine. Let's clear out that old carousel. Right now, the only way to ride it is in your imagination...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_143.step1: It seems my work here is done. Unfortunately, a considerable amount of paperwork still awaits me.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_143.step2: Of course, Markus! I doubt these old planks will put up much resistance when we escort them off the fairgrounds. You can go!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_143.step3: Axel, why do you look so sad? Are you upset that Markus left?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_143.step4: The fair used to bring us so much joy as kids... and now these buildings are a mess. I’ll take that booth apart before it collapses.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_144.step1: Axel, you finished so fast! Even card houses take longer to fall apart!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_144.step2: It was easy. The old beams had already been sawed through by someone.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_144.step3: What are you implying? Someone deliberately tried to damage the buildings?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_144.step4: Maybe it’s just a coincidence... It’s hard to think with those dry branches creaking. Let’s cut the poor tree down and put it to rest.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_145.step1: It’s a shame about the tree. Remember how fluffy it used to be? And how many presents lay under it — enough for all of Gardenridge!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_145.step2: Don’t worry. We’ll replace it with a new sapling, and we’ll come up with something for the gifts.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_145.step3: Come up with what? Santa brought the gifts. Are you planning to write them a letter from town?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_145.step4: Very funny, Axel. But we’ve got work to do - let’s tear down that small tent next!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_146.step1: Lisa, when I talked about Santa, I wasn’t joking! Don’t you remember how the gifts appeared right before our eyes?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_146.step2: Axel, don’t you know there’s no such thing as miracles? All those "Santas" are adults in costume.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_146.step3: I’ll prove I’m right! There must be traces of Santa left at the fair... I’ll search the big pavilion while I take it apart!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_147.step1: I found some wrappers, a leaky bucket, and more cut beams. Doesn't seem like Santa's doing.
