6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_147.step2: But it does look like someone wanted the buildings declared unsafe so the fair would be shut down... probably to buy the land later.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_147.step3: Yeah, that description fits our old friends at Voss&Vale. And as usual, we’ve got no solid proof!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_147.step4: What matters is we’ve foiled them again! We’ll send Voss&Vale’s dreams about our fair straight to the dump — just like this rotten bench!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_148.step1: You’re staring at that empty spot where the bench used to be. Hoping to spot Santa’s boot print?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_148.step2: Ha-ha, very funny. But your skepticism won’t stop me — I’ll find proof that Santa exists!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_148.step3: While you're looking, clear out this trash. We can't even see our own tracks, let alone Santa's!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_149.step1: Here it is! Old letters from kids to Santa! There’s even one from you — asking for a doll you later found under the tree!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_149.step2: that only proves the letters never reached Santa, don’t you?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_149.step3: Or it proves they did - and he brought them with him so he wouldn’t mix up the gifts!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_149.step4: Fine, keep searching for Santa then. I’ll take apart this poor snowman — it’s sad to see what’s left of it...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_150.step1: There we go, all done. I’ll build a new snowman later so he can cheer up the fair visitors again!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_150.step2: One snowman isn't enough to save the mood. The rest of this place is still pretty depressing.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_150.step3: We’ll fix the atmosphere once we finish cleaning! Not much left now — let’s speed up and toss those old sleighs!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_151.step1: Oh no... what if those sleighs belonged to Santa?! And we just threw them away! How will he travel now?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_151.step2: He wouldn’t have gone far on those anyway. And that pile of boxes at the exit would’ve blocked him too — so let’s clear it!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_152.step1: Alright, just the kiosk left to dismantle and we can forget it like a bad dream! Then we’ll put up new buildings for the fair!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_152.step2: Hold on, I think I can fix it! I’ll give the kiosk a little facelift with my tools — and a touch of love!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_153.step1: The kiosk looks great! Remember how Grandma used to hand out hot cocoa to all the kids in town?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_153.step2: Of course I remember! Nothing beat hot cocoa on a frosty day. It really was magical... I wish we could relive it, even just for a bit.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_153.step3: To fill life with wonders, you don’t have to hunt for Santa. You can make them yourself!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_153.step4: Sounds good to me! Let's add some magic to the fairgrounds with a carousel in the town square!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_154.step1: Wow! The new carousel makes such a difference. The holiday spirit is already in the air!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_154.step2: Then let’s not stop there — let’s give the fair a full makeover! We’ll bring back those cozy little cabins!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_155.step1: Axel, this is incredible! Your cabins look so sturdy, they’ll last for centuries — not just a couple of fair seasons!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_155.step2: I'm a pro! They don't call me... wait a second. Oh no! I completely forgot about an emergency job!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_155.step3: Don’t worry, go. I can handle plenty on my own — like setting up the tent! And if I need help, I’ll call Sofia in.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_156.step1: You made that look easy! I don't think my help is needed here. I can't compete with those skills!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_156.step2: And mine are way behind yours! This fair needs a real artist’s eye. What else do you think we should add here?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_156.step3: Now that’s my task! The fair needs more fairy-tale vibes - let’s put Santa’s sleigh here!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_157.step1: It looks amazing! Axel would love this. He'd say Santa has a brand-new ride for delivering gifts!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_157.step2: More like Markus, not Santa. He was the one leaving gifts under the tree when we were kids. I once overheard our parents talking about it.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_157.step3: Good thing Axel didn't hear that. He's been searching the entire fair for signs of Santa today!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_157.step4: Then let’s not crush our friend’s faith in a real miracle! We’ll prep the gifts ourselves, and tell Axel we have no idea how they appeared!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_158.step1: Whoa... that’s a mountain of presents! I can already picture Axel’s face!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_158.step2: The key is making sure nobody opens them before he gets here, or the surprise is ruined.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_158.step3: We’ll post a reliable guard — or rather, build one! A couple of snowballs, a hat, a carrot... and we’ll have a perfect snowman-guard!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_159.step1: Remember making snowmen at Grandma's place? We built so many that there was barely any yard left!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_159.step2: Yep, Gloria complained you couldn’t even see the path to the house because of all the snowmen. Oh — and I almost forgot your grandma’s request!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_159.step3: Gloria heard we’re fixing up the winter fair and asked us to set out the dishes in the kiosk where she used to make hot chocolate!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_160.step1: They say coziness lives in the details. A couple of clay mugs, thoughts of hot chocolate — and I can already feel that winter fairy-tale mood!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_160.step2: You know, this still doesn't feel magical enough. A truly enchanted place needs more gifts!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_160.step3: So what’s the problem? We need more gifts - let’s bring a bag of toys!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_161.step1: There — now Axel will have so many gifts from Santa, he never even dreamed of it. I even tucked a couple of new tools at the bottom of the bag!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_161.step2: You put so much effort into keeping the magic alive for Axel. He's lucky to have you as a friend.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_161.step3: He's always helping me and giving his all. The least I can do is let him keep believing in miracles.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_161.step4: Then let’s get ready for Axel’s return properly! So he can unwrap the gifts comfortably, let’s put a table in the square!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_162.step1: What a lovely table! Makes you want to sit with friends and snack on something tasty!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_162.step2: Yeah, except there’s nothing tasty on it. So let’s set out some treats and turn those daydreams into reality!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_163.step1: Well, well! I finished my job and caught an insanely tasty smell. I didn’t think the trail would lead me straight to the fair!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_163.step2: See any other clues? While we were getting treats, someone brought a mountain of presents!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_163.step3: No way! Are you saying a real miracle happened at the fair? See - and you didn’t believe me!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_163.step4: Not quite, Axel. I think the 'real" miracle still hasn’t happened — it’ll happen only when we finally decorate the tree!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_164.step1: Would you look at that? A Christmas tree really does make everything feel like a winter fairytale.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_164.step2: And every holiday needs one more thing: people who support each other. Even in their silliest dreams.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_164.step3: Axel, what gave us away? How did you figure out the gifts were our doing, not Santa’s?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_164.step4: I was working near the shop you were carrying toy bags out of. Oh — and I grabbed some flags there too. Let’s hang them up!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_165.step1: The flags flutter so cheerfully in the wind... Looks like that was the final touch on the fair. Time to call Markus and tell him!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_165.step2: Forget hints. Let's send an airship over the square and let Marcus figure it out for himself!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_166.step1: Another win over Voss&Vale! Whatever they planned for the fairgrounds, it's not happening.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_166.step2: It’s great, but... this endless race with Voss&Vale is exhausting. I just want to take a little break from the competition...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_166.step3: You know, we’re definitely a couple steps ahead of Voss&Vale now, so we really can finally rest! Forward — I know a perfect spot for it!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_167.step1: Oh, I forgot how comfy this sofa is! It's like it's hugging me with soft foam arms!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_167.step2: I remember you used to sit on it for hours. I even remember you built a grabber arm to pull snacks from the drawers without getting up!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_167.step3: Are you hinting that I'm lazy? We'll see what you say when I throw out those old boxes! Just wait a couple of minutes...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_168.step1: Well, Axel, you actually got up and threw the boxes out! I thought we'd have to work them into the decor as a designer coffee table!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_168.step2: No way, a table has to be sturdy, not cardboard! Otherwise it won't hold important things, like two-liter soda bottles!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_168.step3: Ha-ha, okay, I get it. Then let's put a reliable table in front of the sofa now!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_169.step1: This table good enough for you? Think it can support all that soda you're planning to pile on top?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_169.step2: It works for me, but you should check with Sofia too. She's the one who loves taking up every horizontal surface with her art projects!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_169.step3: Excuse me, but you’re the one who sat beside my glorious three-meter pencil tower — and paid the price when it came crashing down!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_169.step4: Okay, you two are getting way too into this. Let’s drop the argument and grab something to eat.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_170.step1: Now that's a proper snack! After a lunch like this, I just want to flop on the sofa again and listen to some relaxing music!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_170.step2: All our old speakers can play now is the sound of dust rolling back and forth, so we'd better throw them out instead of turning them on!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_171.step1: Hey, Sofia, look! If you lean over the roof railing, you can see our old speakers chilling in the trash bin!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_171.step2: All I can see is the brickwork in the railing shifting, so be careful when you lean over!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_171.step3: You're right, we shouldn't forget roof safety. I'd better patch up the holes in the parapet before everything here crumbles!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_172.step1: No way! I found our time capsule in one of the holes! We put keepsakes and notes with our future plans into that tin box!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_172.step2: How great! Let's see... I found yours, Axel! "I want to help the people of Gardenridge." Wow, your wish really came true!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_172.step3: I always stick to the plan! Your notes should be in here too... Aha! Sophia's wish: "To create!"
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_172.step4: And it came true! Wait, there's a cassette in here. Let's hook up the stereo and see what's on it!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_173.step1: Great, the stereo is set up and the cassette is in... Hmm, I can't hear anything except hiss! Could there really be nothing on the tape?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_173.step2: Looks like the cassette got ruined over time. Too bad we'll never know what was on it...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_173.step3: But I feel like I can hear guitar chords in the white noise... Maybe it was a recording of one of our guitar nights?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_173.step4: Yeah, we used to sing together in our hideout. Let's bring a guitar back to the rooftop!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_174.step1: Let's play something! I've forgotten every chord I ever knew, but that's just a temporary setback.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_174.step2: Wait, I searched the whole time capsule, but among all the stickers and beads, I still couldn't find my note with my plans for the future!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_174.step3: What if it just slipped out and landed somewhere? It's probably still up here on the rooftop.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_174.step4: Before we search, can we refresh ourselves with something? Maybe fruit - the sun is blazing so hard I feel squeezed like a lemon!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_175.step1: These fruits are so juicy I've got enough energy to search for your missing note all night! Don't worry, Lisa, we'll definitely find it!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_175.step2: Do you think the wind didn't carry it off after all this time? Or maybe rain soaked it through?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_175.step3: Don't give up too soon. Nothing's stopping us from trying, right? Let's sweep the floor and see whether the note got lost in the trash!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_176.step1: The note wasn't in the trash... But the floor is nice and clean now, which means our "Top Floor HQ" is one step closer to its makeover!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_176.step2: We've still got a lot of work ahead of us. Those holes need to be repaired before anyone gets hurt.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_176.step3: I'll take this one! I'll repair the floor and also check whether your note got stuck in one of the holes!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_177.step1: Even though we didn't find the note in the floor holes either, I decided not to worry anymore! We came here to relax, not to be sad!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_177.step2: That's the spirit! We'll find your note. There are still plenty of places to look.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_177.step3: Maybe, but let's focus on making our "Top Floor HQ" some cozier!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_177.step4: Then let's lay down a carpet! The previous one got eaten by moths from that old chest Axel dragged in from his attic, so we had to throw it away.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_178.step1: Ah, this new carpet is so soft and fluffy... I just want to lie on it, watch the clouds, and imagine we're up there with them!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_178.step2: Great idea! As long as brick dust from the cracks in the railing doesn't blow into our faces...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_178.step3: Got it — I’ll fix the second section of the roof railing right away. Until then, you’ll have to lie on clouds and carpets in your imagination!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_179.step1: All done, now you can lounge on the carpet all day and not worry about the railing!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_179.step2: Actually, I've got an even better idea. What if we put a tea table on the free part of the carpet?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_179.step3: Exactly! As Grandma says, good rest is impossible without a cup of tea! So a tea table on our roof is a must!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_180.step1: What a lovely table! The view of Gardenridge from here is absolutely amazing. You could admire all the city sights!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_180.step2: The view really is magical, but those old flower pots block it completely. Let's throw them out - broken pots don't belong on our roof!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_181.step1: It's looking a little empty without those pots, don't you think? We should put something here.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_181.step2: Your handmade origami collection used to stand there. Not for long, though - Axel blew it away while trying to learn the French horn.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_181.step3: Hey, that wasn't me, it was... the wind! But Sofia's right, put something there sturdier than paper figures. Like new flower pots!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_182.step1: Ah, these plants are so picturesque! I even want to sketch them... too bad my canvases and paints are in the studio...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_182.step2: Hey, we used to keep your art supplies on the roof for moments like this! Behind that boarded-up door used to be our storage room.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_182.step3: Maybe there's something useful behind that door. I'll remove the rotten boards and we'll find out!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_183.step1: Well, well, what do we have here... records, school photos, T-shirts of our favorite band "Velvet Sparks"... a whole portal to the past!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_183.step2: I remember how we sent letters to "Velvet Sparks" for months, asking them to come perform in town.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_183.step3: We didn’t give up, even after being told our town was too small for their tour. They sent signed T-shirts in the end — and we were satisfied.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_183.step4: These treasures deserve better than a dusty storage room. Let's tidy this place up!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_184.step1: The storage room’s as good as new — it’ll hold many more memories for us! I looked for your time capsule note there too... but found nothing.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_184.step2: Hey, what if it was left in your jeans pockets? Remember, you spilled fruit punch on yourself that day and had to change?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_184.step3: And I hung my clothes out to dry! They're still on the clothesline — we should check the pockets!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_185.step1: I checked those jeans and shirt top to bottom, but the pockets were empty. Not a trace of my note...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_185.step2: Let's look for the upside in everything - at least we got rid of those old clothes, which were long overdue to be replaced with nicer decor!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_185.step3: Let's hang a string of lights in the empty spot, so even sunset won't interfere with our rooftop rest!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_186.step1: The lights made our "Top Floor HQ" so much cozier! But... I hear something odd. I really hope the garland isn’t the source of that noise.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_186.step2: That's not the garland crackling - it's pigeons cooing! Looks like a small flock gathered nearby to admire our roof!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_186.step3: Then let's feed our guests! The Last Floor Hideout isn't just beautiful — it's welcoming, too!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_187.step1: And just like that, the roof has become a lived-in place - we even have feathered neighbors now! I think we can finally rest!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_187.step2: Almost. One last touch is left - we need to repair the water tower. We don't need another flood in Gardenridge!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_188.step1: Lisa, I found your note behind one of the water tower beams...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_188.step2: No way, so that's where it went! I wonder how it even ended up there?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_188.step3: I know the answer to that. Lisa, I...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_188.step4: Look, they're about to launch hot-air balloons below! Come on, let's get closer and watch them rise into the sky!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_189.step1: Wow, these balloons look amazing! Oh, Axel, you were saying?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_189.step2: Ahem, yes... The note wasn't in the capsule because I hid it, and only just remembered now. I just... didn't want your wish to come true...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_189.step3: I don't understand what was wrong with my wish. The note says: "Leave Gardenridge and never come back..." So that's why you did it...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_189.step4: I know what can ease this tension! A fluffy guest ran onto our roof and wants to play with you!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_190.step1: That puppy really lifted everyone's spirits! And Axel, don't worry — I'm not mad at you.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_190.step2: Really? I'm so glad. It was foolish to think the missing note would keep you from leaving...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_190.step3: That plan worked halfway! Lisa did leave, but she came back! And now we're spending time together on the roof again, just like many years ago!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_190.step4: But now we have to go. Grandma texted, asking us to help her friend. We'll learn all the details at the old sewing atelier!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_191.step1: Excuse me, but I need to step away for a bit. I still have a lot to do before Amelia gets here!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_191.step2: You've been trying to talk Amelia into moving to Gardenridge for ages. You must be so excited!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_191.step3: Just as excited as whoever scattered yarn balls everywhere! It looks like kittens ran wild - let's clear this basket.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_192.step1: It is sad to see the atelier like this. It reminds me of my own workshop before we finally brought it into shape...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_192.step2: Yeah, so much here is ruined - whole stacks of fabric are beyond saving. Nothing to do but throw them away!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_193.step1: What’s the plan? Looking at this pile, we could spend all day deciding where to start!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_193.step2: Maybe we pick by counting rhyme? Rub-a-dub-dub, three man in a... table! Bad rhyme, but now we can replace the old work table!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_194.step1: There were so many patterns on that table! It reminded me of our school fashion contest - papers were everywhere back then!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_194.step2: Your whole house looked like a sewing shop in full swing! Even the floor had just as much trash!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_194.step3: But I doubt Aunt Amelia enjoys the chaos of a work in progress. We'd better sweep the floor!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_195.step1: There were sketches everywhere in that mess. They reminded me of the dress we made for the contest.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_195.step2: And I remembered how someone ruined it right before the final show. We fell from the top three to the bottom and lost...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_195.step3: I am sure it was Emma, our 'school queen'! She knew her dress was worse than ours, so she sabotaged ours to win!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_195.step4: But we could never prove it... Anyway, enough about Emma — let's hang new pictures on the walls.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_196.step1: That memory inspired me so much that I sketched a little dress design and hung it on the wall!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_196.step2: I told Amelia the renovation is going great... Oh, what a lovely sketch! I see you added creativity to cleanup too?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_196.step3: We were remembering our school fashion contest. Now we need to fix this window without Axel's help.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_197.step1: Grandma, what are you thinking about? Do you not like how Sofia and I fixed the window?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_197.step2: No, dear! I just cannot stop thinking about your sketch... Why not sew this dress? It is beautiful!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_197.step3: Great idea! I've never forgotten that contest failure. And Emma can't stop us now!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_197.step4: Maybe you are right... But we have nothing to sew on. Just look at this machine - it belongs in the scrap heap.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_198.step1: I can't wait to start sewing! Maybe the dress needs some ruffles... or a couple of ribbons?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_198.step2: I think we threw out our only sewing machine, so we will have to sew by hand... In that case, no ruffles.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_198.step3: We'll handle the sewing machine later. Help me take down those curtains — I have an idea!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_199.step1: Fold here, pleat there... maybe more volume at the bottom? Or top? Hmm, Lisa, what do you think?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_199.step2: You are making a dress out of an old curtain? How original! Though, is it not a bit too stained?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_199.step3: I am just visualizing the dress - it helps with patterns! Now we need new curtains for the window, not the dress.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_200.step1: There, this place already feels much cozier! I am so inspired - I cannot wait to start creating our dress!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_200.step2: Your inspiration is contagious. I am excited too - let's set up the new table and start the patterns.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_201.step1: I say we need more glitter! A longer train! And we need embroidery!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_201.step2: No, glitter would be too much! We are arguing again, just like before the contest. We almost fought before fittings!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_201.step3: Yeah, fashion is brutal! Let's tidy the closet and see what decor we have first, then decide what the dress should be.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_202.step1: Phew, so many jars, boxes, and threads... my eyes are all over the place! I cannot tell what suits our dress best.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_202.step2: Tell me about it - we still have to sort all the ribbons in the second closet. Let's not put it off, we have lots to do.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_203.step1: We sorted all the ribbons, now we need decor... I am starting to think it is easier to skip it than pick the right one!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_203.step2: Sometimes simplicity looks better than extra sparkle. Let's say the patterns are done!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_203.step3: Great! Now let's focus on Aunt Amelia's atelier - let's throw out this old cabinet, it is falling apart.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_204.step1: Now that the old cabinet is gone, it is obvious how dirty these walls are...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_204.step2: we miscalculated the sleeve size! We need to redraw all the patterns now!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_204.step3: Sofia, we redrew them five times! Put the patterns aside - we have a bigger problem. We need to scrub these walls.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_205.step1: The walls are clean... Oh no, Lisa! Soapy water got on the patterns - they are in terrible shape!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_205.step2: No way! It is happening again - our dress is ruined before we even got to sew it...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_205.step3: Then fate itself is against us becoming designers. Well, at least now we can spend all our time cleaning the atelier.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_205.step4: Maybe this dress was a bad idea... Oh we've still got a ceiling to clean. That should keep us busy.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_206.step1: Dear, the atelier looks so much better! Amelia will be thrilled! But... why do you both look so sad?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_206.step2: While cleaning, we accidentally ruined the patterns, so now we cannot sew the dress...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_206.step3: Let me see... The drawings are damaged, yes, but what if we use that to our advantage? Some blurred lines look great!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_206.step4: Right! These curved stains can become the dress's highlight! We urgently need a new sewing machine!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_207.step1: We'll fix this part, change that detail... Wow. The new skirt design is better than the original!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_207.step2: Great news, but did we rush buying that new machine? We do not even have any fabric to sew with yet!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_207.step3: Yeah, I got ahead of myself. Let's store the patterns safely until we sort out materials. We will add a cabinet for them.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_208.step1: There, the patterns will be safe in this cabinet drawer! Unless there is a flood... or a fire...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_208.step2: Before we become total paranoids, let's just digitize the drafts. They will be safe in the computer for sure.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_209.step1: Done, I moved the patterns to the computer and ordered fabric for our dress! Soon those ideas on paper will become real!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_209.step2: I am so excited! While we wait for delivery, I will set up a new yarn basket - I cannot sit still without using my hands.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_210.step1: Wow, that's a lot of yarn. If we don't get any fabric, maybe we should just knit the dress?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_210.step2: Sofia, we cannot knit! And we will not need to - the courier is already here. I will go get the fabric.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_211.step1: We are on the home stretch! We just need to cut the fabric and stitch the parts on the machine. Sounds manageable!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_211.step2: Yep, a few seams, a few stitches, and the dress is done! And no school queen Emma can ruin it this time!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_212.step1: After all these years since that school contest, we finally closed this old chapter!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_212.step2: And what a chapter! I sent Amelia photos of the atelier and the dress - she loves both and wants your dress in her catalog!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_212.step3: Of course we agree! This proof of our talent means more than any first-place award. We will gladly pass Amelia all our work!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_212.step4: Grandma, please handle it with Sofia without me, okay? Axel called - he needs my help right away!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_213.step1: Look, the owner’s diary was under the table! There are some notes about omens...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_213.step2: She writes that she left because of terrifying visions and... spirits! Another ghost story!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_213.step3: Yeah. I wouldn’t be surprised if some poltergeist clawed those holes in the wallpaper.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_213.step4: Or raccoons, like in Sophia’s studio! Let’s patch the holes and look for their tracks!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_214.step1: I didn’t find a single raccoon. But I did watch a deck of cards fall off the shelf all by itself!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_214.step2: Maybe it was vibration from the road. Don’t panic too soon. We’ll find an explanation.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_214.step3: I want to think rationally, but this atmosphere is giving me goosebumps! It’s so... mystical!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_214.step4: The atmosphere is dusty, not mystical. So it’s time to give the floor a good wash!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_215.step1: While I was washing the floor, I felt a dark silhouette staring at me from the corner! I’m serious!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_215.step2: We’re alone here. It was probably tree shadows falling through the broken window, that’s all.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_215.step3: Then why has the doorbell rung by itself three times in ten minutes?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_215.step4: The wind is blowing through the room. Let’s finally fix that window and get rid of the drafts!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_216.step1: The drafts are gone, but... don’t you feel an otherworldly chill in the room?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_216.step2: Old houses have poor insulation. It’s perfectly normal for the temperature to jump around sometimes.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_216.step3: Or the spirits are unhappy with our presence! Look, there’s creepy figure watching us from outside!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_216.step4: That’s just a passerby. But if it makes you feel better, we can hang a curtain so we can close it!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_217.step1: I’m not going near that curtain again! Someone knocked on the pipe next to it!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_217.step2: A rhythmic knocking? That’s just old plumbing acting up. It often makes frightening sounds.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_217.step3: It sounded like ghostly Morse code! Brr, it’s so gloomy in here that anything could start looking suspicious!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_217.step4: Then let’s freshen up the place. We’ll decorate the walls and make it feel brighter!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_218.step1: The salon owner was right about the terrifying visions. Just look how many we’ve seen already!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_218.step2: You know I don’t believe in the supernatural. You’ll see, we’ll find an explanation for all of this.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_218.step3: What if someone summoned dark forces here? And hid a magic circle under the old rug?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_218.step4: All that’s hiding under it is dust and floor tiles. Let’s replace this worn-out rug with a new one!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_219.step1: See?! As soon as we rolled up that old rug, the lights went crazy! You saw it too, didn’t you?!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_219.step2: Most likely faulty wiring. Though I admit, that was pretty creepy...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_219.step3: Even you’re coming around to ghosts. Everything in here feels suspicious now... even those boxes!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_219.step4: Axel, don’t make it worse. Those boxes are just ordinary junk we need to get rid of!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_220.step1: Look, there’s a strange symbol drawn under the boxes! Is that a seal for summoning a demon?!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_220.step2: Let me see. It looks more like a construction mark. But where did it come from, and why is it here?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_220.step3: Who knows? Maybe it was drawn by a ghost builder?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_220.step4: Don’t be ridiculous. I want to sit down and think this through, so we’ll need to set up an armchair!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_221.step1: Wow, this armchair is comfortable! Perfect for figuring out what our secret ghosts are up to.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_221.step2: Whoever scared the owner got exactly what they wanted. She panicked and abandoned the salon.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_221.step3: Maybe we should hold a séance to learn the truth? And I’m only half joking!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_221.step4: You can’t call spirits on the phone. We need a fortune-telling table!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_222.step1: Are we actually going to summon spirits? What happened to your skepticism?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_222.step2: Of course not. A mystical salon just needs the right furniture.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_222.step3: Now that we have the fortune-telling table, it’s time to put some ottomans around it!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_223.step1: In a setting like this, summoning spirits would be very comfortable. And the poltergeists seem to like it too - they've even gone quiet!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_223.step2: The only thing missing is a place to store props for magic tricks. Let's put in a dresser!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_224.step1: You joke about tricks, but maybe magic really does exist... Oh! Did you hear that? A strange mechanical click from the dark corner!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_224.step2: Yes! And a faint humming too! It's coming from that old cabinet. I bet it's definitely not a ghost!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_224.step3: You think it's some kind of device? But what does it do?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_224.step4: Let's grab a screwdriver and find out right now. We need to fix the cabinet and open that drawer!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_225.step1: The drawer’s open!There’s a speaker and a fan hidden in there! And a Voss&Vale sticker on the casing!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_225.step2: I knew it! They faked the drafts, sounds, and flickering lights to scare the owner off!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_225.step3: So now those creeps are using people’s fears against them to snap up buildings for cheap?!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_225.step4: Looks that way... There are no ghosts here... oh, something is hissing behind the shelf! We need to throw out that old cabinet and see who's hiding there!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_226.step1: There was a black cat hiding behind the shelf! And I even know him - he belonged to the salon owner!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_226.step2: Poor thing, he’s trembling. Those creepy effects must’ve scared him too.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_226.step3: Come here, little guy... Oh, he darted under the armchair and hid!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_226.step4: Maybe he didn't like us throwing out his shelf? Let's put a new one in its place!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_227.step1: The new shelf didn’t tempt the cat out. I guess cat psychology isn’t exactly my strong suit...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_227.step2: Here, kitty... Oh, he sounds so pitiful. He must be hungry. Got anything tasty in your pocket?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_227.step3: A tuna sandwich. The perfect bait for stress relief! I'll carefully coax him closer...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_228.step1: The cat is safe now and purring happily! Axel, it's so lucky you happened to pass by the salon. Who knows how long that poor thing would've stayed here hungry!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_228.step2: Actually... I didn't end up here by pure chance. I wanted to find out whether we have a future...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_228.step3: You mean whether we'll manage to save Gardenridge from Voss&Vale? We can lay out the fortune-telling props and try to find out!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_229.step1: The cards are laid out and the crystal ball swirls with mysterious smoke... What vision comes to me?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_229.step2: Hmm... the cards say you don’t need to rush to know the future. You just need to enjoy the present.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_229.step3: Right. We’ll see if we’re meant to be together... uh, fighting Voss&Vale together! To the very end!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_229.step4: Exactly! But first, let's add some charm to this magical setting - let's bring in some flowers!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_230.step1: With the flowers, this place looks beautiful! A truly first-class magical fortune-telling salon!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_230.step2: Now we just need a little more magical décor. I found a few things in the storage room - let's arrange them on the shelf!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_231.step1: There, we've created a real miracle without a single spell!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_231.step2: The salon’s ready for the owner to return. Voss&Vale won’t frighten her out of this place again.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_231.step3: Yeah, I asked Grandma to get in touch with her and explain what really happened here!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_231.step4: Now all that's left is one final touch before she comes back - let's hang up some string lights!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_232.step1: The string lights are glowing, and the salon looks great! No bad omens will ever return here again.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_232.step2: Yep. Time for Voss&Vale to gnash their teeth again - we beat them once more!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_232.step3: Hey there, hard workers! Our former music teacher urgently needs help repairing her studio.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_232.step4: Oh, of course! We're leaving right away - you can tell us everything on the way!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_233.step1: Fresh air is exactly what you need for good, long rehearsals.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_233.step2: I can almost still hear us trying to play hits by Velvet Sparks.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_233.step3: Trying? We sounded just as good as the original! Especially when we hit the right notes!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_233.step4: Your confidence knows no bounds. Hopefully it’ll help you take down that old curtain!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_234.step1: Done! Old curtains are no match for me. And to think I once wanted to become a great guitarist...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_234.step2: You even came up with a stage name! What was it... Axel Thunder? Or Storm? I forgot.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_234.step3: Axel Hurricane! Sounds powerful, right? Though back then, my solos sounded less like a force of nature and more like a bee trapped in a jar.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_234.step4: Hurricane, put that power to good use. We need to hang new curtains on the empty window!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_235.step1: The curtains make it feel cozier! Almost like our old rehearsal base in Bob’s garage. Remember?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_235.step2: We made enough noise to get all the neighborhood dogs howling along. Still, I loved those nights.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_235.step3: We made a great team. But over the years, our paths drifted apart...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_235.step4: What matters is that we’re together again! Grab a putty knife, partner. Time to plaster the walls!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_236.step1: The wall is perfectly smooth. No cracks, no signs of dampness!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_236.step2: Does the broken shelf on that perfect wall not bother you? We can’t leave it like that. It needs fixing!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_237.step1: Behold my work! The shelf is good as new... What are you looking at?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_237.step2: I found our old awards from music competitions! Mrs. Harmony kept them all these years!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_237.step3: It’s terrifying to remember that we got them for lyrical masterpieces like, “My heart is a broken guitar pick”!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_237.step4: Come on, all teenagers are a little... dramatic. At least we have something to remember! So I say we put the awards in the most visible spot!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_238.step1: The awards are so shiny! Mrs. Harmony will be thrilled to see them in such a place of honor.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_238.step2: Yeah, there’s even a trophy for your outstanding drumming! You always said drums were the foundation of any song.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_238.step3: Of course! Drums are the architecture of a track. Without a good rhythm, no song can come together!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_238.step4: No renovation works without a good cleanup. I’ll move these boxes before they get in the way!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_239.step1: Without the boxes, there’s more space. Even my voice sounds different now!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_239.step2: That’s because we’re clearing the space for new sounds. My drums used to stand in this corner.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_239.step3: And I found them in the storage room! They’re dusty, but the drumheads are intact.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_239.step4: Now my hands are itching to play a killer beat! Let’s set up the drum kit right away!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_240.step1: I just played a couple of bars, and they sound amazing — just like when we were young!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_240.step2: Yeah, that was awesome! And you know... I just had a brilliant idea. Let’s bring our band back!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_240.step3: Axel, what band? We’re adults now. We have plenty of serious responsibilities. And renovations!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_240.step4: One doesn’t cancel out the other! Think about it while we plaster the big wall.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_241.step1: Fine, the band idea isn’t so bad. But then we need a new hit!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_241.step2: Definitely. Back then, we sang about escaping boring teenage life for a big, bright world.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_241.step3: Now we can write a song about a place that always calls you back. About Gardenridge, our hometown!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_241.step4: Good idea. But we’ll need a place to write things down. Let’s hang a board on the wall!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_242.step1: All right, I wrote the first couple of lines. Judge my poetic talent, Lisa.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_242.step2: “The place where hearts beat in time, that’s a fact beyond rhyme.” That’s a grade-school rhyme!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_242.step3: I think there’s potential in it. Maybe we should study some textbooks before we attempt songwriting?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_242.step4: Sure. They used to be on the shelf, and now... probably somewhere in storage. I’ll look for them while you get the broken shelves out of the cabinet!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_243.step1: Come on, I was just pressing a few keys. Nothing special...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_243.step2: Hey, guys, I found the textbooks. What are you arguing about?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_243.step3: I’m trying to prove Bob is essential to the band. No one played the piano better than he did!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_243.step4: That’s true, he’s our talent. All right, you fix the shelf while I convince Bob!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_244.step1: Sheet music, solfège books — everything is back in its place. What a beautiful sight!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_244.step2: Yes, the music classroom is starting to transform. We’re finally giving teenagers a place where they can find themselves.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_244.step3: Just like we once found ourselves. That’s worth a lot... Fine, you convinced me. I’ll play with you!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_244.step4: Hooray, old friend, I’m so happy! I’ll celebrate by taking down the second curtain!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_245.step1: I managed to work out some chorus chords while taking down the curtain. They sound really upbeat!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_245.step2: Come on, let me see... I’ll try to come up with a drum pattern!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_245.step3: Then while Lisa’s busy, we should get some work done. Let’s get rid of this old flower pot!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_246.step1: I figured out the rhythm... Now our band is missing one small but very important detail.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_246.step2: What detail? We have a hurricane guitarist, a powerful drummer, and the modest pianist in the world!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_246.step3: We need an actual vocalist, Axel. Your singing always sounded like a wild seagull in distress.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_246.step4: Hey, that was punk rock! Fine, we could use a singer. But first, let’s put this dresser here.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_247.step1: The dresser’s in place, so now we’ve got convenient storage, but... still no vocalist.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_247.step2: What if we ask Sophia? She always sang beautifully, she was just really shy on stage.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_247.step3: Great! With friends around, she’ll feel comfortable and won’t be scared to hit those high notes.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_247.step4: I’ll text her right now! And while we wait, I say we don’t waste any time and hang the curtains!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_248.step1: Curtains are done. What about Sophia? Did she agree to sing for our band?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_248.step2: She said she’d be thrilled to sing with us! She’ll stop by as soon as she’s done with her errands.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_248.step3: Great, we’re going to have a real chamber concert. Only... for a concert, we need a clean stage.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_248.step4: As always, you’re right, our sensible friend. Time to throw out all this accumulated junk!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_249.step1: The junk is at the dump. Now nothing can stop us from preparing for our musical triumph!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_249.step2: Yeah, except the dust, stones, and dry leaves. This floor still needs sweeping!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_250.step1: The floor’s spotless, but some boards are rotten. That could ruin the acoustics.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_250.step2: A creaky floor is a musician’s enemy! We don’t want our hit turning into horror movie music, do we?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_250.step3: So let’s grab the tools and some new boards. This floor is getting fixed whether it likes it or not!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_251.step1: The floor doesn’t creak anymore. You could dance on it now! The classroom is almost ready to open!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_251.step2: And we’re ready for our first rehearsal! I can already imagine music filling this room with energy...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_251.step3: Before we fill the room with energy, we need to put the instruments in their places!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_253.step1: All the instruments seem to be in place... but what if the utility room still has a surprise for us?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_253.step2: Then let’s check! We’ll need a crowbar and a little effort!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_254.step1: There’s nothing in the utility room except memories of us hiding in here while skipping class!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_254.step2: Personally, I never skipped. You forced me in there when I was supposed to be at piano rehearsal!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_254.step3: Come on, it was fun! And now you can play the piano as much as you want.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_254.step4: True, it’s not looking great... But don’t worry, we’ll fix it!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_255.step1: The piano is tuned! The sound is clear and deep. I’m ready to play my part in our song!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_255.step2: I’ve got my guitar tuned. Sophia says she’s on her way up! Our concert’s starting any minute now.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_255.step3: Excellent. But if we start playing too loudly, plaster will rain down on us from that old ceiling.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_255.step4: Safety first. We need to grab a stepladder and quickly patch those gaping holes in the ceiling.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_256.step1: And here’s Sophia! You’re right on time, we’re ready to start!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_256.step2: Axel sent me the draft lyrics for the song. I changed a few things, hope you like it!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_256.step3: I’m sure it’ll be an absolute hit! All we’re missing for the perfect atmosphere is light.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_256.step4: Right, the old lamps are flickering like crazy. Once we replace the lighting, we can finally start!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_257.step1: Every bench remembers stories told beneath the stars, and every path still knows exactly who we are.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_257.step2: Though the stores and houses change as years go by, Gardenridge is where our best memories lie.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_257.step3: Guys, that was amazing! I’m so glad we not only helped restore the music classroom, but also brought our band back for at least one performance!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_257.step4: Then I suggest we bring back one more thing from the past... How about we go stargazing?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_258.step1: I can’t figure out what’s wrong with this rock, but it makes me uneasy.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_258.step2: What’s wrong with it is that it smashed through the observatory roof. I wonder who threw it in here...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_258.step3: You think Voss&Vale used a drone to punch a hole in our roof? That’s getting pretty childish!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_258.step4: Let’s give the rock to the detective. He can deal with the mystery while we move it out of the way!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_259.step1: The rock is in a bag, and the detective will be by soon to pick it up. Yeah, that thing really ruined our stargazing plans...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_259.step2: We can still stargaze. Even surrounded by all this mess, the stars are still beautiful.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_259.step3: All I can see are torn old scrolls and a broken lamp. This mess is keeping me from focusing on the stars. Let’s throw it out!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_260.step1: The mess is gone. Now nothing distracts us from thoughts of the beautiful, endless universe.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_260.step2: Except those poor dried-up plants. They clearly didn’t survive without care and regular watering.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_260.step3: Flowers need care, just like relationships... Without it, they fade away, like these poor things.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_260.step4: You’re getting philosophical today. But these plants are done for. Time to toss them out!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_262.step1: Do you think the detective will find anyone’s fingerprints on the rock?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_262.step2: I don’t know. We can only hope. Footprints on the Moon last for millions of years, after all...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_262.step3: This isn’t the Moon, it’s a disaster zone. Let’s clear those boards before someone trips!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_263.step1: I got rid of the boards! Ahem, Lisa, I invited you here for a special atmosphere...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_263.step2: Oh, the atmosphere is unforgettable! Dampness, dust, and dirty stains everywhere.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_263.step3: Uh, I meant something a little more elevated... But I agree, the dirty walls do ruin the effect.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_263.step4: We can get back to the poetic stuff later. For now, grab some rags — these walls need cleaning!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_264.step1: There, the walls are sparkling clean. We could practically get jobs as cleaners soon!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_264.step2: Yeah, if we don’t freeze first! An icy draft is blowing right over our heads.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_264.step3: In space, the temperature is close to absolute zero... You have to stay close to each other.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_264.step4: I’ll be frozen solid before I can enjoy your fun facts! Let’s fix that giant hole in the dome, fast!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_265.step1: The dome is fixed! Now we can admire the sky in warmth and even... make secret wishes.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_265.step2: I wish Voss&Vale would answer for their schemes. The rock damaged the furniture as well as the dome!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_265.step3: Yeah, a lot took a hit. That old shelf for the star atlases is completely crooked after the impact.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_265.step4: We can’t leave rare books in such terrible condition. Grab the tools, it’s time to fix the shelf!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_266.step1: There, the star atlases are safe now — the shelf is standing straight. Unlike the coffee table...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_266.step2: Yeah, it’s really falling apart. It would’ve been such a nice spot for a cup of tea and a good book...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_266.step3: So what’s the problem? Let’s replace it with a new table, and you can put a whole tea set on it!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_267.step1: The new table fits in perfectly. Oh, Detective, hello! We have the rock ready for you.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_267.step2: Good evening. It looks intriguing. I’ll take it to the lab for a thorough examination right away.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_267.step3: I hope you can find out where it came from. And while you do that, we’ll add a little life to this room with some potted plants!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_268.step1: Looking at these plants reminds me of a fact. There’s a cloud in space that tastes like raspberries!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_268.step2: That sounds delicious! Sitting in a cozy chair, watching the stars, and thinking about raspberries.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_268.step3: And then a spring pokes you through the seat and ruins everything.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_268.step4: Yeah, the old armchair doesn’t fit that fantasy at all. We’ll have to replace it!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_270.step1: Did you know that from space, Earth looks like a tiny blue dot? It’s an amazing sight.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_270.step2: Too bad our copy of Earth looks awful right now. Look, the old globe is shattered to pieces!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_270.step3: We can’t glue the continents back together, but we can replace the old globe with a new one!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_272.step1: The globe is so blue... Just like sunsets on Mars! I’d really love to see one with you...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_272.step2: A blue sunset is beautiful. But we won’t get to see one — our main instrument is beyond repair!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_272.step3: The lens is cracked, the tripod is bent... Without a telescope, this is just a fancy round room!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_272.step4: No problem. This telescope can go, and we’ll get the observatory a new, modern model instead!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_274.step1: This telescope is incredible! I’ve got Venus in view... They call it the planet of love and passion.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_274.step2: Yeah, though the sulfuric acid clouds and brutal pressure do put a damper on the romance.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_274.step3: Yeah, romance and science don’t always go together. Just like this observatory and the word “cozy”.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_274.step4: That’s easy to fix. I have some wonderful prints of night landscapes. Let’s hang them up!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_275.step1: This starry landscape is so inspiring. It makes me want to sit in an armchair and read an atlas!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_275.step2: Sure, except it’s pretty hard to study tiny constellations in this dim light.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_275.step3: I agree, moonlight is very romantic, but ruining your eyesight isn’t worth it.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_275.step4: Don’t worry, we’ll just put a lamp on the coffee table, and our eyes will be fine!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_276.step1: The lamp looks like a tiny supernova! Oh, the detective’s back. Did you finish checking the rock?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_276.step2: Yes. Your mysterious rock turned out to be a genuine meteorite! So it’s hard to say whether Voss&Vale had anything to do with it appearing here...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_276.step3: A meteorite?! Wow! So it could have fallen here all by itself, straight from the sky?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_276.step4: That’s not the important part. A meteorite is a real treasure for an observatory. It deserves a place of honor — let’s clear the debris from the middle of the room!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_277.step1: The detective’s gone to do the paperwork. I still can’t believe a meteorite landed here!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_277.step2: Meteorites are like shooting stars. They grant wishes, so this must be a good sign!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_277.step3: I don’t know about wishes, but it’ll definitely draw the attention of scientists. And that would be a huge step forward for Gardenridge science!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_277.step4: Then it’s time to put our “visitor from space” in the most prominent spot!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_278.step1: This meteorite really does look like treasure. Lisa, I think its fall means something.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_278.step2: A sign that it’s time to replace the roof? I get it. Sometimes a fall can lead to big changes.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_278.step3: Exactly! And our relationship... uh, with space is growing too. That sounds encouraging, right?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_278.step4: It does... Oh, sorry, I missed all of that. I was thinking we should put a wastebasket by the table!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_279.step1: I put in the wastebasket, just like you asked.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_279.step2: Axel, why do you look so sad? Did something happen?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_279.step3: Yeah, it’s just... Our stargazing didn’t go quite the way I hoped it would.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_279.step4: Don’t worry, Axel, we can still look at the stars. We just need to hang them up!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_280.step1: Well, what do you think of these stars? They’re not real, but they’re still pretty amazing!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_280.step2: That’s true! Today’s been full of surprises. The meteorite alone was enough!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_280.step3: And that’s not even the end of today’s surprises... Sophia texted me — her bathroom pipe burst!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_281.step1: There, no water left on the floor. It’s practically sparkling now!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_281.step2: Unlike the walls! Water sprayed everywhere, and now there are awful dirty streaks all over the tiles. What will Bob think...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_281.step3: He’ll think there was a flood, that’s all. But I agree, the walls need washing either way!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_282.step1: Perfect, we finished just in time for Bob to arrive. Come in, don’t be shy!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_282.step2: Hi. As soon as I heard about the flood, I came straight over. Don’t worry, I’ll take care of it.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_282.step3: Thank you, Bob... I just turned on the bathroom faucet, and water started spraying everywhere!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_282.step4: Hmm, the bathroom, you say? I’ll get it sorted out and find out what happened!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_283.step1: All fixed. The pipe threads gave out, but I took care of them. You’re safe from another flood now.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_283.step2: You’re a miracle worker! I... I don’t even know how to thank you!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_283.step3: It’s nothing, really. And I...I could help with something else too. Like replacing the curtains!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_284.step1: The new curtains look wonderful! Bob, how did you know this was exactly my shade of pink?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_284.step2: It’s just... at Gloria’s café, you always choose the mug that color...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_284.step3: What great attention to detail! Too bad this draft is ruining the cozy atmosphere.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_284.step4: Oh, right. I didn’t even think to fix the broken window right away. I’ll take care of it now!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_285.step1: There, no more drafts. Sophia, you didn’t get too cold, did you?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_285.step2: A little, but with such reliable helpers around... I already feel much warmer.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_285.step3: You two are adorable. But I should point out that standing on cold tile still isn’t very cozy.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_285.step4: Absolutely. We need to put a soft, fluffy rug on the floor!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_286.step1: What a lovely rug! It feels so nice to stand on. Bob, your help today has been priceless...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_286.step2: It’s nothing, just call me any... Oh, I dropped a tool. My hands must be wet from the water...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_286.step3: Ha, something tells me wet hands aren’t the only reason for that clumsiness!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_286.step4: Yeah, maybe I was just startled by those broken shelves. I need to fix them immediately!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_287.step1: The shelves look great! Sophia, just look how hard Bob is trying for you...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_287.step2: Lisa, stop it. He’s just a responsible plumber. Oh, I tried to sit down, but this stool is wobbling!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_287.step3: Looks like the damp loosened the legs. I’ll fix it up before you fall and hurt yourself.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_287.step4: Our wrench-wielding knight is here to save the day! Bob, grab your tools and fix that stool!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_288.step1: The stool is ready. It’s solid as a rock now! Wait... Do you hear that strange noise?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_288.step2: Oh no! The pipes made that exact same noise right before the flood started!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_288.step3: Seems the leak isn’t only under the bathtub. The sink pipes are acting up too. I’ll handle it now!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_289.step1: Phew, the riser valve was just rusted shut. I took care of it, though I had to clear out a whole pile of cosmetics to reach it.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_289.step2: Sorry about the mess. I keep so many little things there, and I never get around to cleaning it out.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_289.step3: Look what I found behind the pipes. A little rubber duck. Have you kept it here since school?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_289.step4: What a cute toy! But right now, I suggest we focus on the mirror — it needs replacing before someone gets hurt!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_290.step1: All right, Sophia, tell us! What’s the deal with this mysterious yellow duck from back in school?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_290.step2: I got it on Valentine’s Day from an anonymous admirer. It was so sweet and thoughtful!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_290.step3: Really? Huh... I’m sure whoever gave it to you would be glad to know their valentine liked it...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_290.step4: Bob, you’re glowing from all that blushing! Forget the light bulbs — we’ve got you. Still, we should fix the lighting!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_291.step1: There was also a little note attached to the duck, wishing me a good day.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_291.step2: It said, “So you smile more often instead of getting sad over your textbooks”... I mean, I assume.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_291.step3: You assume? Bob, you quoted it word for word! Our tough plumber turned out to be a secret romantic!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_291.step4: Uh... The shower enclosure glass is cracked, and we need to replace it immediately!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_292.step1: Bob, be honest. You were the one who gave Sophia that funny little rubber duck, weren’t you?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_292.step2: It was me. I was too shy to approach you, so I left it anonymously. I thought you’d toss it out.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_292.step3: I always wondered who could have given me such a sweet gift. I’ve treasured it all these years!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_292.step4: That’s adorable! And while the romance is in the air, let’s get the shampoos put away!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_293.step1: Bob, I never knew you paid attention to me. I thought romance just wasn’t your thing...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_293.step2: I’ve always been a shy guy... and a hesitant one.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_293.step3: This is too sweet! Even the towels couldn’t handle it. They’ve melted into a puddle on the floor!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_293.step4: I must have gotten them wet while I was working. I’ll set up a towel rack so they can dry!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_294.step1: I finished the towel rack. And I checked all the valves again, just to make sure you don’t have to worry about another flood!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_294.step2: Bob, thank you so much! I was terrified to face that awful accident all by myself.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_294.step3: Sophia, for you, I’d fix any disaster! I mean, it’s my job and all that...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_294.step4: You two keep cooing, lovebirds. I’ll finish tidying up and clear out the remaining boxes!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_295.step1: The boxes are out! I’ll put the kettle on in the kitchen, and we can have tea together!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_295.step2: I’d love to have tea with you girls, but I have to go. I’ve got another urgent job today.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_295.step3: You’re such a hard worker, Bob. With a schedule like that, you never get any rest!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_295.step4: Yes, stay a little longer while we finish up here. We still need to put some plants in the bathroom!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_296.step1: My bathroom looks like an expensive spa now! Bob, I don’t even know how to thank you.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_296.step2: You don’t have to. Unless... you’d be willing to have coffee with me sometime.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_296.step3: Actually, I really have to run now. I promised my coach I’d help repair the gym!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_296.step4: Repairs? Then the more people, the better. I’m coming with you. And I’ll bring Axel along!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_297.step1: The fresh paint really brightened the place up! Bob, you did a great job painting the walls.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_297.step2: Thanks, Lisa. My coach always taught us to give one hundred percent in absolutely everything we do.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_297.step3: I give one hundred percent to work too! I’ll rip those boards off the windows with my bare hands!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_297.step4: No need to play the hero, we have a perfectly good crowbar. And we’ll still need your hands!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_299.step1: The boards are off! Did you see how easily I handled them? Barely had to use my right hand!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_299.step2: We’re impressed, Axel. Meanwhile, Bob managed to carry out all those heavy trash bags.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_299.step3: The key is a proper grip and keeping your back straight, so you don’t throw it out for no reason.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_299.step4: Pfft, big deal, proper grip... My back can take it. I could replace those heavy mirrors alone!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_300.step1: Great work. With the new mirrors, the gym looks twice as big!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_300.step2: And did you notice how easily I lifted them to hang them up? My grip is just as good as Bob’s — I can hold anything. Even a whole mountain of balls at once!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_300.step3: I don’t doubt it. But unless you plan to hold them forever, we’d better fix their rack!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_301.step1: Done. As long as I can remember, that rack has been here. My coach always kept the gym in order.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_301.step2: This gym means a lot to you, doesn’t it, Bob? You used to train here as a powerlifter.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_301.step3: Yeah. My coach helped me build more than muscle — he helped me build character.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_301.step4: I owe him a lot. So the least I can do is clean this ceiling!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_302.step1: Axel, you nearly fell off the stepladder while we were cleaning the ceiling! Please be careful.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_302.step2: A stepladder has to be positioned correctly and firmly secured. Safety always comes before records.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_302.step3: I have perfect balance, Bob! My feet are steady on absolutely any surface!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_302.step4: All right, acrobat. You can show off those skills right now — we need to replace the chandelier!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_303.step1: Hey, Lisa, look! Is it just me, or does the new chandelier make my muscles look even better?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_303.step2: Uh... sure, maybe? But now we can also see every scratch on the old equipment.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_303.step3: You’re right. I’ll get the new equipment installed right away — starting with the exercise bike!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_304.step1: The exercise bike is installed. I remember my legs shaking like jelly after long workouts on one.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_304.step2: My legs never shake! They’re incredibly fast. I could outrun a cheetah in a sprint!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_304.step3: Well then, your incredible speed will come in handy when we install the treadmill and test it.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_305.step1: The treadmill works! Phew, I ran so much, I think I’m a little tired...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_305.step2: Maybe take a break, buddy? I’ll fix the floor in the meantime.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_305.step3: No way, I’ve still got energy for that! One treadmill isn’t going to break my spirit!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_306.step1: The floor is restored. The gym is slowly getting back to its old self. My coach will be very happy.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_306.step2: Yeah, the repairs are going full... Hey, Axel, careful! Where are you taking those heavy dumbbells?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_306.step3: I decided to warm up a little! Don’t worry, Lisa, they’re like feathers to me!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_306.step4: Well, if you insist... When you’re done, put them on the rack. We were just about to fix it!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_307.step1: The dumbbell rack is ready! Axel, why did you grab the biggest dumbbell? Put it back on the rack!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_307.step2: I just want to give you a real master class! Watch me lift this much weight with one... Ow!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_307.step3: Axel! You dropped it right on your sneaker! Sit down, let me take a quick look at that bruise!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_307.step4: I’m fine... Though I wouldn’t say no to sitting down. First, we’ll have to fix that bench...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_308.step1: Oh, what a humiliation. I looked so foolish trying to impress Lisa...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_308.step2: Don’t worry. I once ripped my pants during a heavy squat at a tournament. That was a real disaster.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_308.step3: No way! What did you do? How did you not want to disappear from embarrassment?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_308.step4: I didn’t. I finished the set and went to the locker room red as a beet... Your foot is fine, but it needs cooling — I’ll install the air conditioner.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_309.step1: That air conditioner cooled me off. Sorry, Bob. I was acting like a turkey, trying to outdo you.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_309.step2: It’s all right. Men sometimes get competitive. What matters is that we make a reliable team.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_309.step3: Let’s seal our friendship with a glass of... water! But first, we’ll have to fix the water cooler.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_310.step1: Oh, you installed the water cooler! Great! And did you take care of Axel’s bruise? I was worried...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_310.step2: Worried? Really? Ahem, I mean, don’t worry, water is life. It got me back on my feet in no time!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_310.step3: Speaking of water’s healing power... that poor plant in the corner dried out without any care.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_310.step4: If a little water could revive even Axel, this flower should bounce back after a good watering!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_311.step1: Look, the plant perked its leaves up right away! It’s amazing how nature responds to care.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_311.step2: My coach always said that with heart and a little hard work, you can restore anything.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_311.step3: Your coach sounds like a wise man. Now I understand why you want to help him so much.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_311.step4: Then let’s keep going. There’s still a lot to do, starting with those jump-rope hooks.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_312.step1: The hooks are fixed, the jump ropes are up, and the gym will be ready for classes again in no time!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_312.step2: Yeah, the gym is almost ready! But there’s one important thing missing for a good workout.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_312.step3: I know! Exercise is much easier with some upbeat music!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_312.step4: Exactly. My coach loves old-school rhythmic rock. We definitely need to hang a speaker!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_313.step1: The speaker sounds amazing! Oh, Detective, what brings you here? Decided to join our workout?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_313.step2: Hello. I heard about the major wreckage in this gym, and the incident caught my attention.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_313.step3: Really? We’ll lay out the gym mats while you tell us everything!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_314.step1: I made some inquiries... and unofficial sources say the visiting athletes were hired by Voss&Vale.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_314.step2: So they deliberately started the fight and trashed the gym to force it to close? That’s low!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_314.step3: Voss&Vale were counting on the gym owner being unable to restore it, so they could get the building.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_314.step4: Ha, they failed again. We just need to bring in the barbell, and the renovation will be finished!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_315.step1: That’s it, we’re done. My coach will be so happy to see the gym looking even better than before!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_315.step2: It’s just a shame we still have nothing we can use against those Voss&Vale scoundrels...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_315.step3: Not for long. The botanical lab was robbed two hours ago, and Voss&Vale may be involved.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_315.step4: I think we can find clues against the company if we head there right now!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_316.step1: Well, there were no clues in that pile. Too bad, you can often find useful evidence in the trash.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_316.step2: No worries, there’s still plenty of trash left. Maybe the clues are hiding in there? I saw some boxes in the storage room. We can check them!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_317.step1: The boxes only contained nitrogen gas cylinders. Didn’t our criminals leave any traces behind?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_317.step2: What do you mean? They left dirt all over every surface. Just look at these walls!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_317.step3: Time to play forensic cleaners! Let’s grab some sponges and scrub that wall!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_318.step1: I wonder how the robbers got into the lab... Detective, could they have hacked the security system remotely?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_318.step2: Possibly. Voss&Vale often use hackers... And to cover their tracks, they may have deliberately broken the computer!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_318.step3: So if we fix it, we might be able to trace their digital trail? Then let’s get to work!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_321.step1: The computer is fully restored! Everything is ready to hunt down those virtual criminals!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_321.step2: Too bad the hard drive was wiped clean. No trace of a hack. We’ve hit another dead end.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_321.step3: Then we’ll have to go back to looking for physical clues. We can inspect that huge hole in the wall!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_321.step4: It looks like a rhinoceros burst in here last night! Let’s inspect it, then brick it up!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_322.step1: The hole is fixed, and... Oh, Marcus is coming! He can’t know we’re investigating without a warrant!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_322.step2: What are you doing at a crime scene? Conducting an illegal investigation?!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_322.step3: We only came to help clean up, Officer. I can step out if I’m making you uncomfortable.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_322.step4: Yes, Marcus, we’re strictly here as an emergency repair crew! In fact, we were just about to hang a wall panel!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_323.step1: The panel fits perfectly! See, Marcus? We’re simply helping restore the lab.
