6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_323.step2: I can see you really are busy with repairs. All right, you may continue the restoration work.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_323.step3: The interior rescue crew is happy to help! And now I suggest we repair the terminal — those exposed wires are ruining the whole look.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_324.step1: The terminal is working! Marcus, you’re checking the shelves very closely. Looking for something?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_324.step2: Just looking around. You haven’t come across any old papers, personal things, or letters, have you?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_324.step3: Letters? No, we haven’t found any. Maybe there’s something on the terminal? We can connect a keyboard and look around.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_324.step4: Never mind. I have an urgent call. If you find anything, don’t read it. Report it to me right away!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_325.step1: The keyboard is connected... Don’t you think Marcus is acting a little suspicious?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_325.step2: I do. He got awfully nervous when we mentioned connecting the terminal... I wonder why?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_325.step3: Maybe because the terminal controls the security cameras, and Marcus was afraid we’d discover something?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_325.step4: Who knows... But to review the terminal recordings, we’ll first need to restore the entire surveillance system!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_329.step1: The surveillance system is set up. Now we’ll finally learn who broke into the lab!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_329.step2: We won’t. The recordings from last night were deleted... Voss&Vale are one step ahead of us again!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_329.step3: Keep your chin up! Investigations aren’t easy. Let’s get back to good old-fashioned clue hunting!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_329.step4: Right, the Detective just sent a message asking us to inspect the remaining trash. Let’s check it, then throw it out!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_331.step1: All the trash is gone, and we still haven’t found a single clue...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_331.step2: At least the lab looks much better now. That’s an achievement too!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_331.step3: Sure. But look at that floor. It hardly looks like an achievement.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_331.step4: No problem — I just saw a bag of cement in the back storage room. We can fix the floor in no time!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_332.step1: The floor’s as good as new! While repairing it, I found something important in the storage room.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_332.step2: What is it? Evidence against Voss&Vale?!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_332.step3: Not exactly... I found some surviving research samples! Flasks with reagents that somehow made it through the wreckage.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_332.step4: What incredible luck! We need to get them out of the storage room and arrange them carefully!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_333.step1: The solutions are back in place. Axel, thanks to you, we saved part of the local botanists’ work!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_333.step2: You can call me science’s hero! Also, there was another box of seedlings in the storage room.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_333.step3: Live seedlings? That’s wonderful! It means we can restore part of this lab’s plant collection.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_333.step4: Exactly. So I suggest we move the flower pots into the central part of the lab!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_334.step1: Great samples! Weird that Marcus was looking for paperwork instead of anything useful to the lab.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_334.step2: Think Marcus could be in on it with Voss&Vale? Maybe he was helping their people hide the evidence?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_334.step3: Your imagination has no limits. Let’s come back down to earth and look at the ceiling.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_334.step4: Water’s dripping onto the equipment! We need to fix those pipes fast!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_335.step1: Done! The pipes are welded, and every leak has been fixed. The ceiling is in perfect shape!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_335.step2: I wouldn’t say that. It needs more light — time to install some!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_336.step1: The lights work perfectly! Now we can see every corner of the lab!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_336.step2: Yeah, and now we can see the dirty streaks all over that glass door! We can’t leave it like that!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_336.step3: Aye, aye, Captain! Time to bring back the shine. Watch out, stains and smudges!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_337.step1: Now that door is crystal clear. If I accidentally walk into it, it’s not my fault.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_337.step2: Great work. But that large flask in the middle of the lab looks pretty sad...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_337.step3: Yeah, the glass cracked during the wreckage. Don’t worry, though, I can fix it!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_338.step1: Great, we’ve almost restored the laboratory. All that’s left is dealing with the storage units.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_338.step2: Yeah, the criminals were rough on them. They don’t look great.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_338.step3: Maybe we’ll find some evidence against Voss&Vale inside the storage units?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_338.step4: First, a detective check with a magnifying glass. Then we fix the cabinets with a hammer and nails!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_339.step1: I found intact test tubes inside, plus a hidden stash of letters and seeds behind the back panel!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_339.step2: These are letters from Marcus to a lab employee! Sweet poems about her smile and flowers.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_339.step3: Our tough cop writes poetry? So he’s not a villain — he was just too shy about his romantic side!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_339.step4: Seems so. We’ll need to study these seeds. For now, let’s put the test tubes back in place.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_340.step1: The test tubes are in place. I feel like a genius botanist now! Hmm, Lisa, why do you look so sad?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_340.step2: We cleared Marcus, but we still haven’t found any evidence against Voss&Vale...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_340.step3: Hey, we still have those mysterious seeds from the stash! What if they’re an important clue?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_340.step4: Good point... Let’s try sprouting them and see what happens!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_341.step1: It’s alive! I can’t believe it... This is the rare plant that cleans the city’s waterways!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_341.step2: See? We did get one over on Voss&Vale after all! We saved the lab’s main environmental project!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_341.step3: Yes, but we still have no proof they were responsible... You know, Axel, I need some time alone.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_341.step4: Um, all right, of course. Take a break from fighting Voss&Vale. Call me if you need me.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_342.step1: Phew, sometimes it’s so hard dealing with grown-up problems like a damaged roof or a rotten floor...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_342.step2: That’s why you really didn’t want to grow up as a child. You even had a rulebook for avoiding it!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_342.step3: Yeah! I think I hid the notebook somewhere here. It would be fun to find it and see what it says!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_342.step4: We’ll definitely find it! But first, I suggest we throw those rotten boards out of your treehouse.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_343.step1: Sweetheart, look, your rulebook slipped behind the boards! I’m so glad we found it!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_343.step2: Let’s see what it says... “To keep growing up from finding you, hide in the headquarters. That’s why you have to take good care of it.”
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_343.step3: “Rule One: Keep the floor hole-free, or under-bed monsters will sneak off with all the candy!”
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_343.step4: Well, this floor is definitely not up to safety standards! We need to fix that hole!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_344.step1: Now no under-bed monster will get in here. So, what other rules were in your rulebook?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_344.step2: “Rule Two: Spiders are our guards. You must never scare them if they don’t get in the way.”
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_344.step3: Grandpa taught you to care for nature, but these guards took over — cobwebs are everywhere!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_344.step4: It’s time to fire them! Let’s grab a brush and clear the cobwebs off the walls.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_345.step1: The cobwebs are gone! Now for the next rule: “Keep the windows clean so you can spot enemies.”
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_345.step2: Oh, with all those cracks in the windows, you can barely see our garden, let alone any enemies...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_345.step3: We’ll fix that now! Axel taught me to glaze windows, so this will only take a couple of minutes!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_347.step1: All right, the next rule says: “The hammock must always be ready for resting. Escaping from growing up is tiring work.”
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_347.step2: I’m afraid no one can rest in that hammock. The fabric looks ready to crumble into dust any second!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_347.step3: No problem. That just gives us an excuse to replace the old hammock with a new one!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_348.step1: Now you can stretch out in the hammock and read the rulebook in comfort! “Rule Five: Do not let in adults who forbid sweets before dinner.”
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_348.step2: So that’s why you rarely let me into the treehouse! I could only come in with a plate of cupcakes!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_348.step3: Mmm, those cupcakes were so delicious... Too bad there’s nowhere to eat them now — the little table is falling apart, so we’ll have to throw it out!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_349.step1: Sweetheart, how terrible! This is simply unbelievable!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_349.step2: Grandma, what is it? What happened?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_349.step3: I just noticed that poor dried-up plant above the door! It needs to be replaced at once!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_350.step1: There’s a map at the end of the notebook! “Childhood is hidden there.” Hmm, what did I hide?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_350.step2: don’t know, but Grandpa helped you hide it. You two spent a whole week sneaking around the treehouse looking mysterious, and wouldn’t tell me anything!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_350.step3: That’s right! Grandpa left clues too. I know that handwriting. “Four steps south of the easel.” Hmm, but there’s no easel here now. Where do we go?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_350.step4: Don’t worry, I remember where it used to stand. Let’s set it up and get our landmark back!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_351.step1: The easel is ready! All right, four steps south... and we end up right in the middle of the room!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_351.step2: “Now stand on the round island that saves your feet from the winter cold.” What a funny riddle!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_351.step3: A round island? It must be that rug I loved sitting on as a child!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_351.step4: Only the moths ate it ages ago... Let’s lay down a new rug and continue our route!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_352.step1: So, I’m standing on the “island”! Let’s read the map: “Turn to face the captain’s throne.”
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_352.step2: The captain’s throne? That sounds very grand! Could it be Grandpa’s old creaky armchair?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_352.step3: Exactly! Grandpa always sat in it when he came to the treehouse. But it’s in awful shape!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_352.step4: Then we need to replace it. Let’s set up a new armchair worthy of a captain!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_353.step1: The throne is ready! The next step on the map says: “Walk around the supply safe three times.”
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_353.step2: I think it means the little cabinet where I used to hide cookies and candy!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_353.step3: Too bad there’s nothing left of that cabinet. We need a new one to keep going!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_354.step1: We’ve walked around the cabinet. Now we need to “cross the great sea of soft threads to the west.”
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_354.step2: A great sea of soft threads... Could it mean the big fluffy carpet that took up half the treehouse?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_354.step3: Yeah! I used to pretend it was a stormy ocean and try to leap across it with a running start.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_354.step4: Then we’ll need to lay down a new big carpet so we can “cross” it!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_355.step1: Done! The map says: “The answer is hidden where clever paper birds live.”
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_355.step2: Paper birds? Grandpa used to lovingly call your favorite storybooks on the shelves that.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_355.step3: But now the shelves on the bookcase are completely empty. No paper birds or clever books.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_355.step4: That’s easy to fix! I brought a box of your old books. Let’s fill the bookcase.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_356.step1: While we were shelving the books, I found a tin box behind the bookcase! That’s our treasure!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_356.step2: Let’s open it quickly! But for such a special moment, we need to have a tea party!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_356.step3: Good idea! Then let’s put a new tea table in front of the armchair and take a look at the box!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_357.step1: So, inside the box are glass marbles, hair clips, and candy wrappers. Real childhood treasures... Oh, there’s a note too!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_357.step2: A letter from little Lisa! That sounds incredibly touching. I wonder what you wrote?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_357.step3: We’re about to find out. The handwriting is tiny, so I’ll need a little time to make it out.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_357.step4: Take your time, dear. Meanwhile, I’ll bring in another plant to make the room cozier.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_358.step1: Well, would you look at that... I once promised myself I’d grow up so I’d have the strength to help people in trouble. It seems I kept that promise...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_358.step2: Exactly. It doesn’t matter whether you managed to expose Voss&Vale or not. What matters is that you help people who need it. Don’t let exhaustion break you.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_358.step3: You’re right, Grandma. Thank you for the support. I’m glad I decided to visit my old treehouse...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_358.step4: Oh, a message from Axel. The recording studio needs help. Time to help someone in trouble!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_359.step1: The floor looks good as new! Say, how did you even meet the owner of a recording studio?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_359.step2: We ran into each other at a music festival. He was looking for talented local artists at the time.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_359.step3: Interesting. I hope that festival wasn’t as dirty as this place...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_359.step4: Yeah, this place is a total mess. Let’s grab some rags and clean all this grime off the surfaces!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_360.step1: Much better now. But looking at you, I can’t shake the feeling you’re hiding something.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_360.step2: Me? Lisa, how could you suspect your best friend of having some secret plan?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_360.step3: That sneaky look gives you away! Admit it, we’re not at this recording studio for no reason!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_360.step4: All right, I’ll tell you the whole truth. But first, let’s hang some lights. It’s too dark in here.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_361.step1: Let there be light! Much better — now I can see that guilty face of yours. Start talking.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_361.step2: You got me. I didn’t bring you to this studio just for a deep clean.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_361.step3: I knew it! Did you drag us into another adventure? I hope this has nothing to do with crime?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_361.step4: I swear, it’s all completely legal! I’ll explain once we replace that dried-up plant.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_362.step1: All right, stop stalling, Axel! What secret plan is hiding behind all these repairs?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_362.step2: I secretly recorded our song in the music classroom and let my friend hear it. He liked it and offered to record us if we fixed up the studio!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_362.step3: You want to record our track on professional equipment? Seriously? That’s completely crazy!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_362.step4: It’ll be a real hit! Think about it while we hang the blinds.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_363.step1: I don’t know, I’m still having serious doubts. We only played our song once!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_363.step2: And it was legendary! Lisa, our track deserves a proper high-quality recording.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_363.step3: But we’re not professional musicians. Recording in a real studio... it’s unbelievable!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_363.step4: We can do it! Let’s sit down and talk it through. I’ll set up a second chair for you!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_364.step1: This chair is so comfy. You know, your crazy track idea might actually have something to it.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_364.step2: Told you! This will be our big moment, and we’ll conquer all the music charts!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_364.step3: Our song is about Gardenridge. People might really want to hear a track about their hometown.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_364.step4: Exactly! I’m so glad you’re in. I want to do something right away. Like install a shelf unit!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_365.step1: The shelf unit is ready! Sophia and Bob are excited and will be here soon to record.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_365.step2: See? The whole team is here. We’re going to rock this town with our amazing voices!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_365.step3: I hope so! But... is this studio any good? The gear’s old, and no one’s recorded here in ages.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_365.step4: The studio is great, the equipment is just outdated. So let’s replace these old, noisy computers!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_366.step1: The new computers are lightning-fast! Say, why did the studio end up in such bad shape?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_366.step2: A new aggressive label showed up. They shamelessly poached all my friend’s clients.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_366.step3: Monopolists again? They promise newcomers fame and fortune, then take all their rights away?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_366.step4: Exactly. But once we replace the old sound system, that label won’t stand a chance against us!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_367.step1: The new speakers look amazing. It’s a shame the competitors are taking away your friend’s income.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_367.step2: Yeah, they’re making the studio unnecessary. It feels like they just want to bankrupt him.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_367.step3: Yeah... We have to help him save his business and record our track!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_367.step4: We will! But first, let’s lay down a carpet so the bare floor doesn’t ruin the sound.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_368.step1: The soft carpet absorbs the extra echo nicely... Do you happen to know the name of that shady label?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_368.step2: Their logo has a strange abbreviation — two Vs. I think it stands for Voice and Vibe.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_368.step3: Two Vs? That looks like the work of our old enemies. I sense something suspicious here.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_368.step4: Are you thinking what I’m thinking? You look them up online while I install an extra stereo system!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_369.step1: Axel, you won’t believe this! Voice and Vibe was only registered recently! And guess who their main sponsor is?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_369.step2: Voss&Vale? Unbelievable! They set up a shell company just to ruin my friend?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_369.step3: Their plan never stood a chance. Chad’s too talented to give up, even without us.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_369.step4: No wonder, with all those awards! Let’s hang them up so everyone can see what Chad can do!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_370.step1: With the awards on the walls, the studio looks really impressive! Oh, and Sophia and Bob are here.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_370.step2: Phew, we got here as fast as we could. So, when do we start recording?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_370.step3: Yeah, Sophia and I are ready to record. We... ahem, well, we can get started.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_370.step4: That’s the spirit! Then let’s install a microphone right away to record Sophia’s vocals!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_371.step1: Sophia, your voice was incredible as always! You sing the lines of our song with so much feeling...
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_371.step2: I believe it will remind the people of Gardenridge why we love this town and give them strength!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_371.step3: Yeah. So it’s time for Lisa and me to join in and record the beats and keyboards.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_371.step4: Just a couple of minutes. I’ll set up the equipment, then we can begin!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_372.step1: Bob and I recorded everything! That was incredibly cool!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_372.step2: Yeah, I loved it too! Now it’s your turn, Axel. We’re all waiting for your guitar solo.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_372.step3: You won’t have to wait long. I’ll grab my guitar from the storage room, and I’m in!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_373.step1: We recorded all our parts! That was amazing, everyone. We sounded fantastic.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_373.step2: Yeah, and now... do you mind if Bob and I leave you two? We wanted to... go to a café.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_373.step3: So you finally decided to go on a date? Go on, we’ll stay and arrange things on the shelf unit!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_374.step1: The things on the shelves make the studio feel cozier. I think your friend Chad will like it.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_374.step2: Yep! I sent him photos of the studio, and he loved them. He’s already on his way to mix the track!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_374.step3: Can you imagine it? Soon all of Gardenridge will hear our voices! It’ll help bring people together.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_374.step4: It will, but... Well, they say cacti bring good luck. Maybe we should put a couple here so our song is sure to succeed?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_375.step1: The cacti are in place! Our studio looks amazing now. We’ve done something huge!
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_375.step2: We recorded a real hit and saved my friend’s business. I’m incredibly proud of our team.
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_375.step3: So much happened in one day... We deserve some rest too. How about we go to the aquarium and unwind?
6.RoomRepair.location_0_stage_375.step4: Wonderful idea! We’ll look at the fish and celebrate our future musical success.

6.SideQuestTutorialO.dialogue: Wow! Where did this table from ancient times come from?
6.SideQuestTutorialO.dialogue2: Looks like someone brought it back from their travels... Legend says this table can guide its owner to true treasures!
6.SideQuestTutorialO.dialogue3: Treasure, huh? Well, let’s find out if this legend is actually true!
6.SideQuestTutorialP.dialogue: What a disaster! Our first aid kit is completely empty. We don’t even have any bandages left!
6.SideQuestTutorialP.dialogue2: That’s not good. Medical supplies should always be close at hand in case of emergencies!
6.SideQuestTutorialP.dialogue3: Yes, that’s why we need to restock the first aid kits with everything essential. Health comes first!
6.SideQuestTutorialQR.dialogue: Hey, who left this tin can lying around? Someone could trip over it!
6.SideQuestTutorialQR.dialogue2: I don’t think that’s a can... It looks like a knight’s helmet! How did it end up here?
6.SideQuestTutorialQR.dialogue3: Who knows? Maybe some absent-minded knight dropped it centuries ago! Let’s collect the rest and build a whole knight!
6.SideQuestTutorialSS.dialogue: The weather’s so nice today! We should do something fun — days this sunny are too good to waste.
6.SideQuestTutorialSS.dialogue2: Maybe we should have a picnic? Spread out a blanket on the grass, make some sandwiches...
6.SideQuestTutorialSS.dialogue3: Great idea! Then we need to get ready and pack everything we need into a picnic basket!
6.SideQuestTutorialT.dialogue: I heard bright birdsong from outside today, looked out the window, and saw a real parrot!
6.SideQuestTutorialT.dialogue2: That's no surprise. Their migration season is just starting. Soon all the trees around here will be full of colorful birds!
6.SideQuestTutorialT.dialogue3: Then it's the perfect time for a walk. I want to see as many parrots as we can find!
6.SideQuestTutorialU.dialogue: I want to freshen up my place and get an aquarium, but I can't decide which fish to put in it!
6.SideQuestTutorialU.dialogue2: Then let me help. I was really into aquariums as a kid, so I know quite a bit about this stuff!
6.SideQuestTutorialU.dialogue3: Perfect! I'm sure together we can pick the brightest and most colorful fish for the aquarium!
